10592217.en: You two finally reached the mountain's top after a strenuous journey, but all you find on it is just a crooked tree stretching into the air. {name|B} reaches out to its branch and picks some fruits. Then, he looks at the broad landscape with a sigh, seeming much disappointed.
10592217.ch: 沿断壁走了多时，终于登上峰顶。然而上面光秃秃的，只有崖边长着一棵歪脖子的大树。{name|B}探身悬空之处，伸手摘落几枚果子，然后回看远方景致并发出一声叹息。其失望之情已溢于言表。

10592218.en: Haha. I'm not feeling frustrated. We've gained a lot. Now we have wonderful scenery and delicious fruits; our effort bears some fruits.
10592218.ch: 哈哈，我没有灰心。收获颇丰不是吗？眼前是美景，手中是美食。我们也没白来呀。

10592219.en: By the way, I heard that the land in that direction is called Chi You, and is still inaccessible now? Are you going to go there? I also heard that it is very dangerous, and what if I also go there after I cured my Nil Root Constitution and learned martial arts?
10592219.ch: 对了，听说那个方向有一个无法进入的赤幽州，是这样吗？你是要去那边吧？听说赤幽州十分凶险，若我能拔除三阴绝脉体，修成功法，一定要去游历见识。

10592222.en: Okay, let's leave now! There is still a long way before me!
10592222.ch: 好了！我们这就走吧！我也要继续去探寻根绝三阴绝脉体的办法了！

10592223.en: You two reached the mountain's top, but all you find on it is just a crooked tree stretching into the air. {name|B} reaches out to its branch and picks some fruits for you, seeming much disappointed.
10592223.ch: 登上峰顶以后只见上面光秃秃的什么都没有，只有崖边长着一棵歪脖子的大树。{name|B}见状不禁露出失望之色。他探身外出从大树上摘下几枚果子递到你面前来。

10592224.en: I didn't expect to find snacks here. Let's have some before continuing our journey.
10592224.ch: 没想到这光秃秃的山顶还有这种好东西，我们吃了再走吧。

10592225.en: Don't worry, I'm fine. Let's leave now. I must find the cure to my constitution.
10592225.ch: 我没事的。走了走了。我还要继续找呢更觉三阴绝脉体的办法呢。

10592226.en: I heard that the horrible Bipedal Hound outside our wall was killed by the mysterious grandmaster. He's awesome.
10592226.ch: 城墙外那只可怕的环狗被击杀了。听闻是那名神秘的大能再次出手的。真厉害啊。

10592227.en: Yes? But someone said that he was clumsy in the past, to the extent that he couldn't practice any technique.
10592227.ch: 厉害吗？我听说那家伙以前很没用的。学什么都学不会。

10592228.en: Maybe he was like that in the past, but now he's awesome! By the way, do you know where he is now?
10592228.ch: 那是从前！你看人家现在多厉害？话说，你知道这位大能现在在哪吗？

10592229.en: They say that the person is hard to find, but occasionally he will assist the master cultivators in Chi You by going outside the Cultivator Alliance and slaying Mythical Beasts.
10592229.ch: 据传这人神出鬼没，但偶尔会现身仙盟外出手击杀大妖兽，为赤幽州大能解决一些大患。

10592230.en: Maybe let's come there and meet him?
10592230.ch: 不如我们去瞧瞧这位大能去？

10592231.en: Sounds good. Rumors about him are nearly everywhere now, and I'm also wondering that is he so extraordinary as they said.
10592231.ch: 也好，近日关于此人的传闻已传得沸沸扬扬，我倒要看看是不是长了三个头，六条手臂的。

10592232.en: Two cultivators are standing in front of the Nether Demon Bounty Board. They are discussing something in a low voice.
10592232.ch: 只见两名修仙者站在冥妖悬赏榜前交头接耳，似乎正在议论什么。

10592233.en: Hey, have you heard of the master cultivator that came to Chi You recently? I heard that someone saw him fighting Mythical Beasts outside the Cultivator Alliance.
10592233.ch: 喂，你知道日前来到赤幽州那位大能的来头吗？据说他常常出没在仙盟外击杀大妖兽呢。

10592234.en: Something about him? He was looked down upon by people and was rejected by sects many times before. I'd say he was a loser.
10592234.ch: 有什么来头？以前就一废物，没有一个宗门愿意收的，还经常遭人欺负！

10592235.en: Well? I have heard something different. It is said that he was so talented that he declined all sect's invitations. Even his journey was full of thrilling adventures, and that's why he is so renowned and powerful now.
10592235.ch: 怎么你听到的跟我的不一样？据我所知人家从小就天资卓绝，根本看不上任何宗门。后来在外游历更接连遇到奇遇，所以成就了这身本事。

10592236.ch: 哪听来的消息？这一点也不可信！

10592237.en: And what are you saying? How come such a grandmaster was originally a loser?
10592237.ch: 我看你那才是瞎扯，怎么可能是个废物呢？

10592238.en: The two cultivators begin to dispute, both flushed in anger. You still hear their voices come from the distance after they walked away.
10592238.ch: 这两名修仙者为了这名“大能”发生口角，吵得面红耳赤，直到二人走到远处仍依稀听得二人争辩之声。

10592239.en: Two cultivators are standing in front of the Council Hall. They're discussing something in low voices.
10592239.ch: 两名修仙者正在仙盟议事大厅前轻声讨论。

10592240.en: I heard that a mysterious cultivator has come to Chi You and defeated many Mythical Beasts that have plagued here for so long.
10592240.ch: 听闻一名神秘的修仙者来到赤幽州中，此人已经出手击败不少为祸赤幽州的大妖兽。

10592241.en: I guess he must be a heaven-chosen cultivator. Maybe the Master is also willing to recruit him into the Cultivator Alliance.
10592241.ch: 这等天骄，不知盟主可有意向将之招纳进仙盟之中。

10592242.en: In fact, he is a rogue cultivator. Maybe that grandmaster prefers to be alone.
10592242.ch: 这位神秘大能，乃是一介散修，想必是个独来独往的异侠。

10592243.en: It would be wonderful if I could see him in person. I am really curious about him.
10592243.ch: 我真想亲眼看看这位大能，见识一下此人风采。

10592244.en: Someone said that the person may appear outside Cultivator Alliance and is usually found hunting the monsters that causing trouble in Chi You. Since now we're idle, let's go out and see if we could stumble upon him!
10592244.ch: 据闻此人浪迹于仙盟之外，时常出手击杀为祸赤幽州的强大妖兽。左右无事，不如我们去碰碰运气吧！

10592245.en: You see a cultivator is engaging in a fierce battle against a monster. He parried several attacks from the monster and finally slew it.
10592245.ch: 前方一名修仙者正与妖兽恶战，妖兽几次施袭都被修仙者化解，最后还被其出手斩杀。

10592246.en: Guess the cultivators in Chi You would be safer now.
10592246.ch: 这样总算能为赤幽州修仙者尽点力了。

10592247.en: It's been a long time, my friend. Would you like to meet me in the tavern? I'll wait for you there.
10592247.ch: 好久不见了，朋友。愿意陪我去酒馆一聚吗？我在那儿等你，不见不散。

10592250.en: Hey, he seems to be the master cultivator that came to Chi You these days!
10592250.ch: 咦，他好像就是近日来到赤幽州那位大能！

10592251.en: Whoa! Master cultivator, would you mind going to the tavern and having a drink with me?
10592251.ch: 好厉害！大能，我能请你去酒馆喝一杯吗？

10592252.en: ...Sorry, but not now. I'm too busy.

10592253.en: The cultivator does not look at the woman. He gazes into the heavy clouds on the horizon and sighs. Then, he rides on his flying sword and glides into the distance in seconds.
10592253.ch: 这名修仙者没有那名女子，他看了看远方低压的层云，叹息一声，然后驾驭飞剑腾飞半空，只眨眼间便去得远了。

10592254.en: I know you will come to Chi You, and here I am.
10592254.ch: 我就知道你一定会来到赤幽州，所以也到这边来了。

10592255.en: I have finally cured my Nil Root Constitution and restored my spiritual roots. Now I can absorb Qi and practice martial arts as everyone did.
10592255.ch: 我的三阴绝脉体已经成功拔除，灵根也已恢复。如今我与常人无异，可以吸纳灵力，修炼道法。

10592256.en: Years ago, I found the name of Supreme Forge in a long-forgotten secret tome. The place is said to be a crucial point in forming lands at the beginning of the world, and I went there to endure its flame, ice, and lightning bolts. Then I found my body brand new.
10592256.ch: 我很早就从一本失传散佚的秘典中找到一个名为大冶台的地方。彼处据传乃是八荒初成之际，塑造一方陆地的关键枢纽。我当日前往此地，任由身体遭受火焚冰裂雷击之劫，竟将身体塑造一新。

10592257.en: Fortunately, the Supreme Forge seemed somewhat tranquil on that day, and I survived the countless harsh trials. However, it left me a hidden danger since then.
10592257.ch: 那日大冶台中似乎正值虚弱之时，我虽受百劫竟然勉强生还。只不过从此之后体内落下一个极大的隐患。

10592258.en: Now I must spend months dispelling the pure fire inside my body every year. But at least I managed to get rid of my Nil Root Constitution and can be considered a cultivator.
10592258.ch: 如今隐患每年都会反扑，叫我不得不耗费数月驱散体内阳炎。不过，如今我总算辟除三阴绝脉体，与一般修仙者无异了。

10592259.en: After I solved it, I began my cultivation immediately. But I made my breakthrough and reached perfection only recently.
10592259.ch: 我发现自己身体恢复正常后，便立即修炼，直到不久前才成功突破玄关，勉强大成。

10592260.en: I heard that master cultivators from all over the world will come to Chi You, and I come here too. Maybe I could find my old friends here.
10592260.ch: 我听闻当世大能都已经来到赤幽州中了，所以便也过来看看，没准能遇见几位往日的故人呢？

10592261.en: And here you are. We meet again.
10592261.ch: 你看，这不就遇见你了么？

10592262.en: People always say that we should repay a drop of water by a spring. I remember your warm words, and here is my gratitude to you.
10592262.ch: 常说滴水之恩，也当涌泉以报。当日你给过我不少鼓励，我铭记心中，这些是我的一点小心意，请你笑纳。

10592263.en: Just at the time you are talking, a cultivator runs into the tavern. The person looks around and finds {name|B}, and steps forward to make a deep salutation.
10592263.ch: 正当你两叙旧之际，一名修仙者突然闯入酒馆之中。此人环顾周遭，最后盯住{name|B}并急步上前，一下拜倒地上。

10592264.en: Grandmaster, I've been admiring your deeds for so long! Now I want to become your disciple, will you accept me?
10592264.ch: 大能，在下对你仰慕已久，希望拜在门下，恳请您收纳门墙！

10592265.en: Well?! Then... what should I do?

10592266.en: Thank you, but currently I don't want to have disciples.
10592266.ch: 对不起，我现在还不打算收徒。

10592267.en: Then when will you want? I can wait for it.
10592267.ch: 什么时候可以呢？我可以等。

10592268.en: I really hope to become your disciple. I'll do my best for you if you could be my master!
10592268.ch: 在下真心期望能够拜倒大能门下，若此番如愿，日后亦必尽心孝敬师父！

10592269.en: Well, why do you seem surprised? Have I done something wrong?
10592269.ch: 咦，为何师父脸有诧色？是弟子有什么做得不好吗？

10592270.en: Nothing special... I recalled my past.
10592270.ch: 不，为师想起一些往事罢了。

10592271.en: You're right. I should test the candidate before accepting the request.
10592271.ch: 你说得不错，我应该对之考量再三，这才将之收录门墙。

10592272.en: Thanks for choosing me, but currently I prefer not to have disciples. You may as well learn from other master cultivators.
10592272.ch: 在下暂未有收徒的想法。八荒名师，所在多有，还请阁下另选大能投效学习。

10592273.en: Alright! You declined me today, but I will return someday and ask you again!
10592273.ch: 好吧，今日你虽然不肯收我为徒，不过我不会放弃的！

10592274.en: The cultivator keeps talking to {name|B}, and their voices attracted other persons. Hearing the grandmaster that slew the monsters outside the wall is here, the patrons in the tavern erupt with cheers.
10592274.ch: {name|B}被这名修仙者缠着无法分身，二人闹出了些动静来，酒馆之中听闻击杀城墙外妖兽的大能便在此处，顿时哗然一片。

10592275.en: Good friend, I'm not available now. Would you like to meet me outside Cultivator Alliance shortly after?
10592275.ch: 朋友，我现在不便抽身，可否请你稍后在仙盟外一聚？

10592276.en: I come to Chi You for an important matter. When I was trying to reforge my body in the Supreme Forge, I saw an incredible mirage in great pain.
10592276.ch: 其实这次来到赤幽州，我还有一件大事要办。我于大冶台重塑身体之际，身体虽然十分难受，但精神却进入到一片奇妙的幻境中。

10592277.en: I noticed a monster in a dark corner. The beast breathes with ominous wind, and its eyes shine with evil sparks. It is struggling against the things that confined it in the depth of the land.
10592277.ch: 我在那片幻境中，看见了一只藏身暗处的妖兽。此兽口喷戾气，眼放邪芒，一直在地底挣扎，以求破困而出。

10592278.en: Then I returned and began my cultivation, and soon reached perfection. However, I still remember the monster I saw that day, and I am in search of more information on it since then.
10592278.ch: 我成功重塑体质以后，立即修炼，不日大成。但是我对幻境中的妖兽还是很在意。便四处寻觅这妖物的音讯。

10592279.en: I finally found something in the records from the Manual Pavilion. It is an ancient beast that was sealed by grandmasters that came to Chi You centuries ago.
10592279.ch: 我遍阅多地琅琊阁秘录后，大抵知道了这妖兽的来历。相传古代有一妖兽被远古之际来到赤幽州的大能击败封印。

10592280.en: It was confined deeply underground and fed on the ill intentions from the Mind Sea of the cultivators in Chi You. It may still do harm to our world if one day it breaks out.
10592280.ch: 此兽困于地底，不断以赤幽州修仙者识海排出的恶念为食。若有朝一日破困而出，他会重新为恶八荒。

10592281.en: And now it has nearly recovered. I'm afraid that it will soon escape in a few centuries.
10592281.ch: 这恶兽，如今已经恢复得差不多了。只怕没数百年就要破困而出，为祸八荒。

10592282.en: The reason behind my dream to be a cultivator is to eradicate monsters and uphold justice.
10592282.ch: 我当初矢志成为修仙者，就是为了斩妖除魔，一振八荒正气。

10592283.en: So I won't sit back and see the monster do harm. But my cultivation is still not firm, and I fear that my strength is not sufficient in dealing with it.
10592283.ch: 因此，我不能放任这妖物重现人世。但是我大成不久，仍未有十足的信心将这妖兽击败。

10592284.en: You want to go with me?

10592285.en: That's good. We'll secure our victory against the monster.
10592285.ch: 甚好，你若一同前往，那么取胜的成数便大大增加了。

10592286.en: I'll set off now. Good friend, I'll talk to you again after I slew it!
10592286.ch: 我这就准备启程。朋友，待我成功斩杀此妖，再好好叙话！

10592287.en: The monster is in the cave in front. It will be a tough battle. Have you got prepared?
10592287.ch: 妖兽就蛰伏于前方深窟之中。一旦进入，便是一场恶战，你准备好了吗？

10592288.en: The monster is defeated by your combined power and vanishes into a dark mist. {name|B} delivered the last blow, but he seems to be pensive instead of cheerful. He gazes into the cave blankly.
10592288.ch: 妖兽被你们击败后，化为漫天黑气，飘散不见。{name|B}亲手击败妖兽，却未露欢愉之色，只是抬头呆呆的看着前方情形，露出一副若有所思的样子。

10592289.en: You see tears flowing down {name|B}'s face...
10592289.ch: 你细看之下，发现{name|B}竟已泪流满脸……

10592290.en: Hope you won't mock me... Let's go.

10592293.en: {name|B} turns back from you. He seems to be wiping the sweat on his forehand. Then he walks away several steps and stops there.
10592293.ch: {name|B}背过身去，似乎抬手擦了擦汗，然后才举步离开。但他只迈出半尺便又停住。

10592294.en: I've traveled a long way. I was caught in frustration and wanted to give up many times, and even now I couldn't figure out why could I succeed in it.
10592294.ch: 这一路走来，其实有好几次我都要气馁，要放弃。现在回过头去想想，我也不明白自己究竟是怎么坚持下来的。

10592295.en: Maybe I am just too obsessed with it. Or maybe your encouragement really cheered me up.
10592295.ch: 或者只是我自己的执念，或者是你对我作出鼓励，让我重新振作。

10592296.en: Either way, you have my deepest gratitude.
10592296.ch: 但无论如何，我都想给你道个谢。

10592312.en: Please, grandmaster! I really hope to be your disciple!
10592312.ch: 请你一定要将我收录门下！

10592318.en: You come to {name|B}'s residence and find he reading books there.
10592318.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，而他正在屋内研读书籍。

10592319.en: Finally, I find you here! Well, I have a little gift for you.
10592319.ch: 可终于找到你了！呃，这些小玩意，希望你不要嫌弃。

10592321.en: Nothing special. Because you encouraged me, you cheered me up, so I...
10592321.ch: 之前你给我打过气，鼓励过我，所以……嗯，就是这样。

10592425.en: I'm sorry, but I must go. Maybe we could discuss it later?
10592425.ch: 对不起，我要离开一会了，回头再说吧？

10592426.en: Hmph. I have been scorned for years, and I've had it enough! Do you think I will fear that? Go ahead!
10592426.ch: 哼，天下人看不起我，糟践我！我早就看透这一切了！来吧，我才不怕你！

10592427.en: Hmph. I thought you were a master cultivator, but what you did really ruins your reputation! Get away from me!
10592427.ch: 哼，阁下修为不低，行的却是鼠窃狗偷之事，真叫在下大失所望。今日之事暂且作罢，告辞了！

10592428.en: Didn't expect you to be a filthy thief!
10592428.ch: 没想到你竟是个卑鄙龌鹾，窃人私物的恶徒！

10592429.en: Well... No. I'm too unqualified for it. You must be kidding, right? Please, don't do that again.
10592429.ch: 啊？这……我何德何能啊？你是拿我开玩笑是吗？不，不可以这样的。

10592430.en: Thank you, but I still want to rewrite my destiny with my power. I'm sorry. I'll remember your kindness.
10592430.ch: 我知道你希望照顾我，但我希望用自己的力量摆脱这个残酷的命运。对不起，你的好意我心领了。

10592431.en: Maybe the time for that hasn't come yet. I'd be glad to become your sworn sibling after I succeed in solving my problem.
10592431.ch: 我还不配与你结义。但我会一直努力，直到成功。那时我们再结此金兰之义吧。

10592432.en: I'm sorry, but I'd like to focus on my search for the cure of my constitution. Perhaps it's not the time to discuss romantic affairs.
10592432.ch: 对不起，我现在只想专心拔除体内三阴绝脉的阴气。儿女情长之事，只好暂时放下了。

10592434.en: Alas... I read many manuals but never put those martial arts to use. I fear that you won't be able to learn anything from such a master.
10592434.ch: 唉……我虽然读了一肚子的秘籍，但从未练成秘籍上记载的功法。我没资格成为你的师父。

10592435.en: I'm too weak to become your disciple now, but I will grow into a powerful cultivator in the future. Maybe we could discuss it on that day.
10592435.ch: 对不起，我现在还不配成为你的弟子。不过你等着，总有一日，我会克服困难的。到时，你若仍有此意，我们再细细详谈？

10592436.en: I'm sorry. I'm busy restoring my spiritual roots now.
10592436.ch: 抱歉呢，我现在只想专心恢复自己的灵根。

10592437.en: Alas, I'm too feeble to engage in the cultivation with you now. I'm sorry.
10592437.ch: 唉，以我现在的体质，根本无法与你一起修炼。对不起啊。

10592438.en: Maybe next time? Let's spar for three whole days after I become a cultivator!
10592438.ch: 改天吧？终有一日，我会成为一名真正的修仙者，到那时，我们再比试。比个三天三夜！

10592439.en: Good! Though I haven't practiced any martial arts or spiritual skills, I believe my knowledge from books is no inferior to you cultivators!
10592439.ch: 好！我无法修炼功法灵技，可我看过很多秘诀秘笈，见识可不一定比你们修仙者差呢！

10592440.en: I want to be a cultivator, a real cultivator. I'll wander the world and uphold justice against all evil if my dream could come true...
10592440.ch: 我希望成为一名真正的修仙者。到那时，我就可以遨游于天地之间，斩妖除魔、行侠仗义……

10592441.en: Do you like it? Feel free to take it.
10592441.ch: 你喜欢这个东西吗？尽管拿去。

10592442.en: I couldn't accept your gift, since I've not done anything that helped you.
10592442.ch: 无功不受禄，我不能接受你的礼物。

10592443.en: Thank you for being so generous, but I'd like to get what I want with my power.
10592443.ch: 我希望凭着自己的本事，闯出一片天地。你的好意，我心领了。

10592444.en: Thank you, but I can't agree to the request. I couldn't even practice Martial Arts, let alone protect my close ones.
10592444.ch: 抱歉，你的请求我无法答应。灵根软弱的我，无法修炼功法，更无法保护身边的人。

10592445.en: Sorry, but I can't agree to it.

10592446.en: Sorry, I can't agree to the request.

10592449.en: Thank you, but you deserve a better master.
10592449.ch: 对不起，我不配成为你的师父。

10592450.en: Thank you, but I'm afraid that my spiritual roots won't allow me to learn them.
10592450.ch: 你的好意我心领了。我的灵根十分软弱，根本无法妥善学习你的功法。

10592451.en: Thanks, but I'm not in the mood for sightseeing now.
10592451.ch: 对不起，我没心思享受这片刻闲暇。

10592452.en: Sorry, my spiritual roots won't bring you any good in Dual Cultivation.
10592452.ch: 对不起，我灵根软弱，根本无法与旁人双修。

10592453.en: Why do you want to spar with me? You're a formidable cultivator, and I could not even begin my cultivation. You will defeat me effortlessly!
10592453.ch: 不打也罢。你是厉害的修仙者，而我只是个灵根残废无法修炼的废人，怎么可能打得过你呢？

10592454.en: Sigh. I'm not in the mood for debating anything.
10592454.ch: 对不起，我实在提不起心情与你论道。

10592455.en: Will my dream come true? Or will I give up someday and be resigned to my constitution?
10592455.ch: 我真怕有朝一日我会坚持不了……败给自己，败给这三阴绝脉体。

10592456.en: I have failed so many times in curing my Nil Root Constitution... They are even more frustrating than the trouble itself.
10592456.ch: 三阴绝脉体固然让人沮丧，但更绝望的是，在寻找根治办法的过程中，我不曾看见一点曙光。

10592457.en: I have tried many methods, but all of them are proven ineffective. Will my perseverance come to nothing?
10592457.ch: 试过的办法越来越多，剩下的希望却越来越少。我真怕自己无法坚持下去。

10592458.en: Take it if you like it. It's no use for a person with such feeble spiritual roots.
10592458.ch: 你喜欢尽管拿去，我的灵根一日不曾恢复，这天下所有的东西我都用不着。

10592459.en: Thank you, but it would be the sect's shame if I am recruited.
10592459.ch: 算了吧。像我这样的人，没有宗门愿意接纳我的。

10592460.en: The time for it hasn't come yet. I'll try to cure my constitution, and when I'm powerful enough someday, I'd be glad to accept the request.
10592460.ch: 对不起，我无法答应此事。我会继续努力拔除体内三阴绝脉的阴气，等到我变强那天，我才能安心答应你的请求。

10592465.en: Thank you, but I'd better not do it now. I would be glad to teach you everything that you are interested in if one day I get rid of my Nil Root Constitution.
10592465.ch: 抱歉，我不能答应你。不过若有朝一日我成功摆脱了三阴绝脉体，你仍觉得能从我身上学到东西，那到时我自当倾囊相授。

10592466.en: Now I'm not qualified to become your apprentice. I'll try my best to get rid of the negative Qi in my body and become a cultivator.
10592466.ch: 今时今日我还无法成为你的徒弟，但我会尽快找到拔除我体内顽固阴气的法子，好成为一名正常修仙者。

10592467.en: Thanks, but I'm too preoccupied to have sightseeing.
10592467.ch: 对不起，现在还不是我停下来欣赏美景的时候。

10592468.en: I'm afraid that it's not wise to have Dual Cultivation with a person inflicted by Nil Root Constitution.
10592468.ch: 我还是那个身负三阴绝脉体的废人。与我双修无法使你获得好处。

10592469.en: Maybe we could have a spar after I am as powerful as you.
10592469.ch: 等我实力与你不相伯仲的时候再跟你切磋吧。

10592470.en: Good! My knowledge could finally be put into use.
10592470.ch: 好！这样一来，胸中所学总算用武之地了。

10592471.en: I'll never falter in the face of difficulties. I must find a remedy for my spiritual roots!
10592471.ch: 任何困难都不能让我退缩。我一定要治好自己的灵根！

10592472.en: I will be a cultivator. I will!
10592472.ch: 我一定要成为一名真正的修仙者！一定！

10592473.en: You're my friend. What's mine is yours. So just take it.
10592473.ch: 你是我的朋友，我的东西就是你的东西，拿去吧。

10592474.en: Thanks for your invitation, but I think it would be better if I join your sect as a powerful cultivator in the future.
10592474.ch: 我会尽最大的努力提升自己，让你的宗门接纳我的。但再此之前我是不会进入任何宗门的。

10592475.en: You offended me first, and you'll take the consequences!
10592475.ch: 今日你冒犯我在先，可莫怪我拿你练手试锋！

10592476.en: Thank you, but I must find the formidable monster in Chi You and kill it. Only then could I think about other matters.
10592476.ch: 抱歉，赤幽州中暗藏绝强妖兽，我得先将隐患解决。其余的事情我不得不暂且放下。

10592478.en: I see. But the monster in Chi You is so worrisome. I must slay it before we could discuss any other matters.
10592478.ch: 抱歉，赤幽州中的妖兽十分强大，不将之击杀，我实是寝食不安，遑论其他事情。

10592479.en: Thanks, but maybe later. I must slay the monster in Chi You first.
10592479.ch: 我不能答应你。赤幽州的妖兽乃是隐患，我得先将之铲除，才能安心。

10592481.en: Thanks, but maybe later. The most important thing now is to eradicate the hidden monster in Chi You.
10592481.ch: 抱歉，我暂时不能答应你。眼前最重要的是击杀赤幽州暗藏妖兽。

10592483.en: Sorry, I'm too busy to have sightseeing.
10592483.ch: 抱歉，我有大事未了，暂无余暇观花赏月。

10592484.en: I see, but I couldn't agree to your request now.
10592484.ch: 抱歉，我暂时不能答应你。

10592485.en: That's good. A spar is a fit test for one's strength. However, I'm occupied by other matters, and I cannot engage in a spar with you now.
10592485.ch: 甚好，切磋正是验证自身实力的绝妙法子。不过眼下大事未了，我还不能与你比试。

10592486.en: I have read so many manuals and tomes. Let's debate about anything and everything!
10592486.ch: 我遍阅诸家秘籍，参透天下秘卷，论道正是我的所长，放马过来！

10592487.en: Finally, I've cured my Nil Root Constitution.
10592487.ch: 千辛万苦，总算将三阴绝脉体的阴气彻底拔除。

10592488.en: I came to Chi You only to find it a desolate land full of dangers.
10592488.ch: 亲临赤幽州才发现这竟是一片四面八方都充斥危机的险地。

10592489.en: No one would befriend me in the past, and you were the only person that encouraged me many times. I feel deeply grateful to you and am willing to give you everything you asked as my gratitude.
10592489.ch: 昔日无人愿意成为我的朋友，而你却几次予我鼓励。我心中十分感激。不要说这小小物品，但凡我身上有的，你只管拿去就是了。

10592490.en: It would be impolite to refuse, so I'll accept it.

10592491.en: Thanks, but maybe later. I'm occupied by other matters now.
10592491.ch: 我有大事未了，还是暂且不进入宗门了。

10592700.en: You released a formidable blast brimmed with the energy from the steed's horn and sent everything around you, as well as those cultivators, into the sky. Now, you are standing on flat ground full of dust, ember, and gravel.
10592700.ch: 你得到青马额角灵力的协助，挥手间将众多修仙者一并击退并把此地夷为平地。当前四周惟有漫天余烬，满地碎石。

10592701.en: You try to teach {name|B} your Taoist Seed, but a strange force from his spiritual roots blocks it. It seems that his body is not ready for a Taoist Mind yet.
10592701.ch: 你尝试对{name|B}传入道种，然而他的道体遭到三种先天真阴之气纠缠阻绝，竟无法接纳你的道心。

10592702.en: {name|B} staggers away from your side. He seems to be heading to the tavern.
10592702.ch: {name|B}摇摇晃晃的从你身边走过，似乎朝酒馆方向去了。

10303001.en: A glow flicked out from somewhere in front of you, followed by a deafening sound. Rocks roll down from nearby hills, and your vision is blurred by clouds of dust. You could only notice three figures running through your side - a person is being chased by the other two.
10303001.ch: 前方一道光华闪过，轰隆巨响随后发出。不远处山石崩塌，烟尘大起。混乱中，几道人影从中闪出，一前二后追逐而过。

10303003.en: Don't worry. She has been wounded in our previous assault and wouldn't go too quickly.
10303003.ch: 没事，先前围攻时已伤了她，走不快的。

10303004.en: The fleeing figure runs like a fierce gale, but suddenly, the person stumbles into the ground. She rolls to your front, and you see a red stream at the corner of her mouth. The woman is breathing heavily; she supports herself against the ground with her arms, trying to stand up again.
10303004.ch: 前面逃避追逐之人原本飞奔极快，但猛的足下一个趔趄摔倒地上，几下滚到你面前来。这人嘴角留着血痕，正大口喘气，撑住地面，似乎想重新站起。

10303006.en: The other two soon arrived here. Seeing you stepping forward before the woman, the two break into vile smiles after a slight hesitation.
10303006.ch: 两名追逐之人奔行如飞，眨眼来到女子身前。而你两步踱出，拦在前面。两名追逐之人先觉诧异，继而露出狞笑。

10303007.en: Hey, good friend. What do you mean?
10303007.ch: 喂喂，朋友，你这是什么意思？

10303008.en: No more talks. Draw your weapons now.

10303009.en: Thank you... I know a good shelter, and could you please escort me there? I must tend my wounds now...
10303009.ch: 感激……我知道一个安全的地方……可否请你送我到那儿避敌养伤？

10303010.en: They are minions from the Mindsnap Temple, and they... are trying to kill me...
10303010.ch: 这两人乃蚀心殿之人，他们……打算加害于我……

10303011.en: The Qi here is unstable. Maybe there were cultivators engaged in a fierce fight in this place not long ago.
10303011.ch: 此地灵气动荡，可能不久前曾有多名修士在此大战了一番！

10303012.en: The Mindsnap Temple has many secrets. Maybe I did something they prohibited, or I ruined their plan or something similar before. I really have no idea about it.
10303012.ch: 蚀心殿神神秘秘的，也许我触犯了他们什么禁忌，也许撞破了他们的大事，我自己也搞不明白。

10303013.en: And could you please escort me? I am seriously wounded, and I'm afraid that I couldn't be back if I went alone...
10303013.ch: 可否请你护送我一程，我受伤颇重……只怕难以坚持去到安全的地方。

10303014.en: Thank you... Here is my destination. It hides in a secret place, but you'll find it following the map.
10303014.ch: 多谢……这是我居住的敌方，所在极为隐秘，你只需依地图标示走就好了。

10303015.en: The woman stands up feebly and hands something to you. At the next moment, she spits out a mouthful of blood and collapses to the ground again.
10303015.ch: 这名女子挣扎站起，但才将东西交到你手上，便吐了口血重新跪倒地上。

10303016.en: A map from a mysterious lady. You noticed a place marked with a red dot on it.
10303016.ch: 不明身份女子的地理图，上面用红点标注了一个地点。

10303017.en: You unfold the map and find it is a detailed chart of Yun Mo. You noticed a bamboo hut in northern Yun Mo that is marked with a red dot.
10303017.ch: 你展开地图，只见上面详细画着云陌州的山川地理。其中云陌州北部画着一个竹庐，并用红点标注。

10303018.en: The woman manages to stand up with much effort. She breathes heavily, and moments later, she staggers away from here.
10303018.ch: 这名女子挣扎着支持起来，她喘息一阵，颤颤巍巍的离开了。

10303019.en: The woman grits her teeth and stands up. She then walks away from the spot, and the two persons in black hurry up to chase her.
10303019.ch: 眼前女子咬紧牙关，重新站起，然后迈步走了，两名紧随的黑衣人见状亦急急忙忙追赶而去。。

10303021.en: Thanks for your escort. Now I'll begin curing my wounds here, and would you like to come to my residence again after one month?
10303021.ch: 感谢你一路相送，接下来我需闭关养伤。能否请你一月后再度光临寒舍？

10303022.en: After I restore health, I'll find treasures for you as an expression of my gratitude.
10303022.ch: 我养好伤后，自当外出寻觅珍宝，赠送予你，好报答你的救命之恩。

10303023.en: Please visit me here at the time we agreed.
10303023.ch: 请你届时再度光临寒舍。

10303024.en: You're here! I went outside for treasures, but I found nothing valuable. Take these fruits if you like, that's all that I can present to you now.
10303024.ch: 你来啦？养好伤后，我外出寻找珍宝，可惜也没找到什么好东西。唉，我身边也只有这几个果子上得台面，请你暂时收下。

10303025.en: Thanks again for saving my life! From now on I'll stay here for cultivation and tending my wounds. Please visit me here if you need a listener.
10303025.ch: 多谢你在恶人手中救下我。今后我打算在这里养伤修炼，希望你能多来跟我说说话。

10303026.en: You come to {name|B}'s residence but find she is busy packing for a journey.
10303026.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，只见她正收拾细软，背负行囊，似乎准备外出。

10303027.en: Hey, you're here! I remember my promise, and recently, I have been wandering everywhere to find something as my gift.
10303027.ch: 是你呀？日前不是答应过要找到好东西报答你的救命之恩吗？最近我为了这事一直往外跑呢。

10303028.en: I made a divination on Yun Mo these days and the oracle read that, "Under gentle breezes and balmy sunlight, sharp metal protrudes from the earth." So today is a good day for treasure hunting!
10303028.ch: 我算到近日云陌州为“风息晏和，锐金破土”之象，因此打算到外面找找好东西，没准能有所收获呢？

10303029.en: Do you want to go with me? Any treasure found in the journey will be yours, okay?
10303029.ch: 你要不要跟我一起去？找到好东西的话归你，怎样？

10303031.en: The treasure land hides in a verdant forest. However, you can't feel the slightest flow of air here, and a strange pressure is haunting you.
10303031.ch: 藏宝之地林木葱郁，十分优美，然而这周围纹风不动，一股无形压力总是萦绕身侧，让人十分不自在。

10303032.en: {name|B} crouches on the ground not far from you as if examining something. Just at the moment when you step forward, monsters emerge from somewhere around you...
10303032.ch: 不远处{name|B}半蹲地上，正在查看什么，你正要跟上，周围突然闪出数只妖兽……

10303033.en: Sigh. The Feng Shui here indicates that there must be an astounding treasure. However, someone had already brought the trove away, and we arrived late.
10303033.ch: 唉，此处风水特异，应是埋藏重宝的地方，看来有人先我一步，将东西起出带走了。

10303034.en: Disappointed? No... Well, maybe I feel disappointed indeed. My efforts in these days are all in vain.
10303034.ch: 失、失望？没有此事。也许有一些吧，多日费心查探，结果空手而回。

10303035.en: Well, I promised to find a gift, a precious gift, for you! That's what I could do to repay you!
10303035.ch: 呵，我不是说了吗？我是想找一样珍贵的宝物转送给你，报答你救命的恩德啊。

10303036.en: Yes, it's not safe here. We should leave now.
10303036.ch: 不错，此地不宜久留，咱们快走。

10303037.en: And take it, please. I found it in a deserted cave dwelling in front of us when you fought those monsters. I guess it is a legacy from some master cultivators.
10303037.ch: 对了，这个给你，刚刚你对付妖兽时，我在前方一个废弃的洞府中发现的，应该是什么大能修士留下的吧。

10303038.en: What a pity! It turned out that I arrived here late in the end...
10303038.ch: 可惜！看来我终究是慢了一步……

10303039.en: You see a person in black fighting with {name|B} at a distance. {name|B} is impaired by her former wounds and falls into a disadvantage.
10303039.ch: 只见远方一名黑衣人正与{name|B}正在恶斗，{name|B}伤势未曾痊愈，暂处下风。

10303040.en: You... Aren't you Bitterfly's... Or are you the other now?!
10303040.ch: 你……你不是蝶怨的……你变回来了？！

10303041.en: You are about to finish off the person in black, but a cyan haze envelops you. After your vision clears again, you find the opponent has gone.
10303041.ch: 你正要将眼前黑衣人一举击败，未料周围青烟四起，遮蔽目光，待其消散之后，面前黑衣人已不见踪影。

10303042.en: {name|A}, let's chase down the person! We couldn't let the enemy go!

10303043.en: {name|B} kneels down to the ground and breaks into fierce coughs as she finishes speaking.
10303043.ch: {name|B}话音刚落，便跪倒地上剧烈咳嗽。

10303044.en: Sigh... Don't worry, that's caused by my former wounds. A brief rest will do.
10303044.ch: 唉……上次的旧伤便复发罢了。不碍事的，我休息一会就好。

10303045.en: Yes. The minions from the Mindsnap Temple.
10303045.ch: 想当然，便是蚀心殿之人。

10303046.en: Never mind. I designed my residence to be a secret shelter that cannot be detected by ordinary people. It seems that I should stay there and never step out of my door.
10303046.ch: 无妨，我的住处经过特殊布置，寻常人无法察觉。看来，我还是安分留在住处为好。

10303047.en: Okay, I'll be back now. And I guess the persons from the Temple are also searching for me here, so please don't linger in this place for too long.
10303047.ch: 嗯，我回去了。看来蚀心殿之人也在附近搜寻我的踪迹，你也不要在这附近多逗留了。

10303049.en: Here is a remote wilderness. You hear someone talking amid the wind howling across pines.
10303049.ch: 此间地处荒野，极为偏僻。虎虎松风声中隐约听得人语之声。

10303054.en: Your condition is worsening. The Elder said that you will undoubtedly die from it.
10303054.ch: 你的情况越来越严重了，长老说这样对你没有好处，你会死。

10303055.en: I know. And leave here as soon as possible. The persons from the Mindsnap Temple are investigating the place, and you wouldn't want to encounter them alone.
10303055.ch: 知道了，快走吧。蚀心殿的人总在附近查探，你孤身一人，若撞上了总是寡不敌众的。

10303056.en: Thanks, I'll go now. Are you okay?

10303058.en: You follow the voice to see who is talking, but you only find an empty ground. Maybe the two persons have left.
10303058.ch: 你循声查探，只见远方空无一人，看来交谈之人已分别离去。

10303059.en: You come to {name|B}'s residence. The gate is open, and a piece of cloth from someone's robe rim hangs on a sharp rock near it.
10303059.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，只见门扉洞开，半截衣摆布料挂在门边尖石处。

10303060.en: Nobody is in the room now. The desk and the chair are scattered on the ground - she left here in a hurry. But you see a booklet in this room; its faint fragrance draws your attention.
10303060.ch: 屋中空无一人，只见周围桌椅歪放，看来屋中主人离开时颇为仓促。此外，屋中摆放一本薄册，上面透出阵阵幽香。

10303061.en: You open the booklet. It reads like a record of a talk between {name|B} and a senior named Lingsu.
10303061.ch: 你查看书册，上面似乎记录着{name|B}与一名叫作灵素的高人会面的情况。

10303063.en: Lingsu: Ask me to save you? I spent half of my life studying poisons and toxics, and please go elsewhere if you need medicine, good girl.
10303063.ch: 灵素：我半生钻研毒物，你让我救你？小姑娘，你怕是找错人了。

10303064.en: I know one of your poisons, Mind Mirage. It is odorless and colorless and takes effect only and exclusively on the soul. That's just what I need.
10303064.ch: “幻蜃蚀心”无色无臭，但此药不走经络，直取神识，能绕过肉身毒杀意念。我要的就是这味毒药。

10303065.en: Lingsu: Your condition is indeed unheard of. But the poison may also kill you, the one speaking to me now.
10303065.ch: 灵素：你处境确是特异。但“幻蜃蚀心”也有可能将“你”毒死。

10303066.en: I will die someday if I let things follow their course. Die under the poison is at least... swifter, I guess.
10303066.ch: 这样下去，我迟早也是死。被“幻蜃蚀心”毒死，好歹痛快一些。

10303067.en: Lingsu: An interesting thought. But the Mind Mirage's recipe requires many precious and rare herbs. I only made two doses in these years, one for myself against powerful enemies, the other as a gift to my friend. It would be hard to concoct the third one now.
10303067.ch: 灵素：有意思。“幻蜃蚀心”配制不易，需各种奇特药草，多年来我只配成两服，其中一服为我对付强敌所用，另外一服赠予友人。如今再要配制，可十分艰难。

10303068.en: Please just tell me where the herbs grow, and I'll pick them for you according to your instructions.
10303068.ch: 前辈只需告知材料生长之处，我自当一一配齐，带到您面前。

10303069.en: Lingsu: Good. I'd be glad to follow its procedure again if I have enough ingredients. And listen, the most important herb in its recipe hides in Yun Mo...
10303069.ch: 灵素：甚好，若非采药不易，我倒挺乐意再配制一份“幻蜃蚀心”玩玩。这味毒药的最重要的材料在云陌州中……

10303070.en: You hear someone approaching, it's {name|B} returning home. Her pale face indicates that she might have a narrow escape just now. She looks at you, and then her eyes are attracted by the booklet on the desk. You feel a slight surprise on her face, but she calms down the next second.
10303070.ch: 只听外面脚步声起，{name|B}已回到家中，只见伊人脸色煞白，似乎惊魂未定。她先看了你一眼，又瞥了瞥桌上薄册，讶色一闪而过，随后复归宁定。

10303071.en: You are here? Sorry for having you wait for me, I just went out foraging. I want to gather some herbs to cure my wounds.
10303071.ch: 你来啦？抱歉，我到外面采药配制几味治疗伤势的药。

10303072.en: Well? Are you reading my diary?

10303074.en: I... I made an enemy in the past. The enemy excels in concealing the traces and would find me or retreat at any time.
10303074.ch: 从前……从前我结了一个仇人，仇人神出鬼没，突然而来，突然而去叫人捉摸不定。

10303075.en: So I decided to have the most unnoticeable poison as my defense, and I went to visit Lingsu the Alchemist for help.
10303075.ch: 因此我想求一味天下间最隐秘的毒药防身，便找到了炼丹师灵素。

10303076.en: Maybe you'll ridicule me. It happened a long time ago, and at that time, I was obsessed with crossing others and making trouble.
10303076.ch: 倒叫你见笑了。那是很久以前的事了……那时候的我，性情古怪，很爱惹是生非呢。

10303079.en: Well? Looks like you are annoyed. I'm just kidding.
10303079.ch: 噗呲，怎么看起来倒是你生气了？跟你开玩笑呢。

10303082.en: Since you're here... What about having a cup of tea? I drew fresh spring water just now, and I'll make a Calm Tea for you.
10303082.ch: 来都来了，试试我的手艺如何？我给你泡一壶“息心茶”，我专门在外取了泉水回来泡的呢。

10303083.en: {name|B} smiles and steps into the inner chamber. She warms her cups with boiled water and puts dried tea into a pot. Soon, she presents a bottle of fragrant tea to you. She has a cup for herself first, and after smelling the aroma and drinking her cup half-empty, she fills yours with the same jade-green beverage. You notice the booklet has gone.
10303083.ch: {name|B}微微一笑，款款而入，来到内室。她取茶暖杯，煮水出汤，十分娴熟，只片刻间，便已将茶备好。她轻嗅茶香，先喝了半杯，这才满意的笑笑另倒一杯并将碧油油的茶汤呈到你面前。与此同时，那本记事的薄册已不见踪影。

10303084.en: It's at the best temperature now. Have a try before it tastes stale.
10303084.ch: 当下茶温正好，放凉了风味不佳，请尽快喝了吧。

10303085.en: You sip the tea. Its refreshing aroma drifts into your mouth, followed by a faint floral scent. You try to feel its aftertaste, and you see {name|B} is looking at you, her eyes full of expectation.
10303085.ch: 你轻抿茶汤，只觉一股清香灌入，后调微觉百花气息。还想细细品味，{name|B}却一脸期盼的看着你。

10303086.en: This tea will benefit cultivators a lot. I hope you like it.
10303086.ch: 此茶对修士颇有裨益，希望你喜欢。

10303087.en: Well. Thanks for visiting here and having a talk with me.
10303087.ch: 嗯，多谢你能来这陪我说说话呢。

10303088.en: I see. Remember to come here if you have time. See you!
10303088.ch: 好吧，若有闲暇，不妨来我这玩呢。

10303089.en: Today you're traveling in Yun Mo, and you see a lonely but familiar figure far away in the wilderness. It's {name|B}.
10303089.ch: 这天你正在云陌州行走，却见旷野远方，一人独自前行，观其形貌，依稀便是{name|B}。

10303090.en: The last time I was preparing tea for you, I found there were clusters of Mind-cleansing Herbs in this place. The herb is poisonous, and I decided to burn them all to save innocent lives.
10303090.ch: 上回采“息心茶”之际，我发现这附近有大片净念草。此物于世间有害，我这便打算将之找到，一举烧了，以绝后患。

10303091.en: I'm not that feeble, but... Well, yes. The journey ahead would be dangerous, and I can't say whether I would get caught by monsters here. Would you like to go with me?
10303091.ch: 我没那么娇弱。嗯，不过……前途危险，这野外又不知道藏着多少凶险，想想也真的可怕。要么你陪我走一趟？

10303092.en: Well, you're so considerate. Let's go. I know the Mind-cleansing Herbs grow near here. But you need to perform <r>Geomancy</r> to reveal its precise location.
10303092.ch: 呵，你可真体贴，这便走吧。据我所知，净念草便在不远处，届时以<r>堪舆</r>之法查探，便能找到。

10303093.en: Uh? Are you worrying about me?
10303093.ch: 嗯？所以你是在担心我，对吗？

10303094.en: Oh, I see. Seems that I rejoiced too soon.
10303094.ch: 呵呵，好吧。害我还白高兴了。

10303095.en: I know the Mind-cleansing Herbs grow near here. But you need to perform <r>Geomancy</r> to reveal their precise location.
10303095.ch: 据我所知，净念草便在不远处，届时以<r>堪舆</r>之法查探，便能找到。

10303096.en: Oh... Well, let's set off now?

10303098.en: The herbs grow in the lair of monsters. I'm afraid that I would be assaulted if I ventured into it. Could you please deal with the monsters there? If so, I could sneak into the lair and burn the herbs.
10303098.ch: 净念草生长在妖兽聚居之地，若再前行，恐怕便会遭遇妖兽袭击。届时可否拜托你对付妖物，我便偷空进入，一举烧毁毒草。

10303099.en: You defeated the monsters here, and at the same time, you saw the shrubs at some distance before you were all engulfed by fire. {name|B} glides through the air and lands at your side.
10303099.ch: 你将妖兽一一击败，前方远处大片草丛已腾起火舌。{name|B}则驾驭法器，御空而回，停在你身边。

10303100.en: I thought I did something good. The plant is an ingredient for poisons, and now they are eliminated.
10303100.ch: 此物为提炼毒物的毒草，如今将之烧毁，总算是为八荒大陆做了件好事。

10303101.en: {name|B} stands beside you and glimpses at you occasionally. She seems to have something to say.
10303101.ch: {name|B}陪在你身边，偶尔用眼角余光瞥了瞥你，似乎欲言又止的样子。

10303102.en: Well, no... You stand here silently, and I thought you might hope to have someone staying at your side, so...
10303102.ch: 没有呀。你站在这里不说话，我觉得陪你站一会也挺不错的。就……

10303104.en: {name|B} then walked away, but she turned her head back after only a few steps.
10303104.ch: {name|B}当先便走，不过只往前走了几步便又回过头来。

10303105.en: And, thanks for accompanying me here.

10303106.en: What a good deed! I must record it in my diary. Let's go!
10303106.ch: 今天做了件好事，回去要用小本子记下来！走喽走喽。

10303107.en: {name|B} stretched herself and walked away, but she turned her head back after only a few steps.
10303107.ch: {name|B}伸个懒腰当先便走，不过只往前走了几步便又回过头来。

10303108.en: Well. Good to have you here. Thanks.

10303109.en: You see two persons in black are attacking {name|B}. She is struggling to dodge their fierce strikes.
10303109.ch: 只见两名黑衣人围攻{name|B}，将其压制得喘不过气来。

10303111.en: Why do you say that? She is not {name|B}, and let's finish off her.
10303111.ch: 说什么傻话？！她不是{name|B}，赶紧下杀手拿下了。

10303112.en: Yes, yes. You should better kill me now before I claim your lives.
10303112.ch: 是啊是啊，不赶紧下杀手，换我打倒你们，可都别想活了。

10303114.en: No more hesitation! She is not the one you knew!
10303114.ch: 还犹豫吗？她不是你认识的那个人！

10303115.en: The two persons' moves are increasingly aggressive, and {name|B} is barely able to defend herself.
10303115.ch: 两名黑衣人说完，果然出手逐渐狠辣，{name|B}已逐渐抵挡不住。

10303116.en: You defeat the two persons, and {name|B} walks to you from behind. She waves her hand, and her opponents fall into silence; their heads droop down.
10303116.ch: 你将二人击败，{name|B}已从后而至。她素手轻轻一挥，二人头脑歪倒，立即没了动静。

10303117.en: Hey, haven't I said that? You should better kill me, or I'll claim your lives. (Coughs.) But... they are not easy to deal with...
10303117.ch: 呵呵，我不是说过吗？换我打倒你们，你们可都别想活了。咳咳，这两狗腿子身手不弱……

10303118.en: Obviously! And I got injured seriously. Damn it... I have so many wounds these days, and a full recover will take a long time...
10303118.ch: 这不是明摆着了吗？这伤还不轻。可恶，近日接二连三的受伤，可不易康复。

10303119.en: Yes. They are from the Taoist Mind Pavilion.
10303119.ch: 他们当然不是蚀心殿的人，他们是道心阁的狗腿子。

10303120.en: Any questions? If I were in their condition, you would find me dead now.
10303120.ch: 怎么？有问题？彼我之间倘若易地而处，恐怕现在死的便是我了。

10303121.en: Hmph. I can walk on my legs and can find the way home with my eyes. No need to do that.
10303121.ch: 哼，我双腿未瘸，人也没傻，自个儿回去便可以了。不劳相送。

10303122.en: Well. Take this. You defeated them and you get the loot.
10303122.ch: 啊，这两是你打倒的，他们身上的东西应该归你。

10303123.en: {name|B} walks away. Suddenly, she flips something into the air, and the next moment it falls before you. It's an embroidered pack.
10303123.ch: {name|B}渐行渐远，只见她手一扬，一个小物件抛上高空，呼的一下落到面前来，那是一个锦囊。

10303124.en: {name|B} halts halfway. Then, she turns her head back and throws you a sharp, strange glance.
10303124.ch: 正在前行的{name|B}身形微微一顿，她转过头来的一瞬间眼中厉芒放出，迥异从前。

10303125.en: I am {name|B}. Nice to meet you.

10303126.en: {name|B} grins and steps away to her residence. Soon, her figure disappears into the wilderness.
10303126.ch: {name|B}说完，轻轻一笑，回过身去，朝她的住处方向而去，眨眼间便没了踪影。

10303127.en: {name|B} walks to her residence. Soon, her figure disappears into the wilderness.
10303127.ch: {name|B}朝她的住处方向而去，眨眼间便没了踪影。

10303128.en: You come to {name|B}'s residence, but no one is in the room. The desk and the chair here are not neatly arranged as usual but scattered on the ground. It seems that she has been out for some reason. Maybe you could encounter her by <r>taking a walk near here</r>?
10303128.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，只见屋中空无一人，内室一应几案桌椅，都散乱摆放，大异往日整齐划一的情况。看来其人已经外出离开，也许<r>在附近</r>查探一番便能遇上她吧？

10303129.en: You see {name|B} is standing on a hill and looking into the distance. She coughs fiercely, but her expression is ferocious. She seems to be searching for something.
10303129.ch: 只见连连咳嗽的{name|B}在小丘上眺望远方。她神态间带着一丝戾气，四下扫视，正在寻找什么东西的样子。

10303130.en: It's you? Hmph. I'm looking for... a thing that will certainly ruin the world. Yes. And I'll destroy the thing. That's all.
10303130.ch: 是你？哼，我在找……唔，我一定是在找什么颠覆八荒的危险之物，并要将其一举销毁。嗯，一定是这样。

10303131.en: Yes. Thanks to her for giving me an excuse to rest. What a nasty troublemaker.
10303131.ch: 是的，拜她所赐，我应该好好养伤。真是个麻烦的东西。

10303132.en: Oh? You must be wondering why I am not as gentle and polite as before? In other words, why am I so rough and uncouth now?
10303132.ch: 是吗？你定是觉得我昔日里温柔娴静，温文尔雅，温和沉静，现在则大大咧咧、粗鲁不文、恶心难耐。

10303133.en: It's just because she, the other me, has gone. It's sad to find that I revealed my true qualities, right?
10303133.ch: 不过，恐怕要叫你失望了。那个“我”一去不复返了，现在这样子，才是真正的我。

10303134.en: Together with me? What if I tell you that I am now planning a journey into the underworld?
10303134.ch: 陪我？我正准备往炼狱里走一遭，你要来吗？

10303136.en: {name|B} is slightly surprised by your words. However, she dispels her emotion with a scornful grin and leaves.
10303136.ch: {name|B}微露讶异表情，不过这表情一闪即逝，她不屑地一笑，转身去了。

10303137.en: She keeps searching for something in this place silently and only pauses in the afternoon. Now she is sitting on the ground; her lips and face are all pale as if she has used up all her strength.
10303137.ch: 她一言不发在附近搜寻半天，终于在午后停下来坐倒地上。只见伊人嘴唇上血色褪尽，脸色煞白已是十分难受的样子。

10303139.en: Hey, I won't pay you for following me a long way here. I'll go.
10303139.ch: 喂，跟了一路，好算作跟班费吧。我回去了。

10303140.en: {name|B} wipes away the sweat on her forehead and sighs. Then, she stands up again and walks away to her residence.
10303140.ch: {name|B}擦了擦额头上的汗水，轻轻叹息一声，重新站起，朝住处回去了。

10303141.en: Hmph. Indeed, but mind your words.
10303141.ch: 哼，有意思。只是不会好好说话。

10303144.en: {name|B} smiles and turns back. Her investigation begins again.
10303144.ch: {name|B}微微一笑，转过身去，自顾自四下探索。

10303152.en: You come to {name|B}'s residence. Her room is in a complete mess, but there is a red-covered booklet lying open on the desk.
10303152.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，只见四下里凌乱不堪，内室桌面横放一本已经翻开的红皮薄册。

10303153.en: You check the booklet. It reads like a record of a talk between {name|B} and a senior named Tianyi.
10303153.ch: 你查看书册，上面似乎记录着{name|B}与一名叫作天一的高人会面的情况。

10303154.en: My end is near. Senior, please save me.
10303154.ch: 晚辈命不久矣，故请前辈救命。

10303155.en: Tianyi: Do you... really know what Sharp Strand means?
10303155.ch: 天一：你……真的明白“千钧一发”究竟是什么法子？

10303156.en: Senior, I know your punches can shatter mountains and split oceans. And your move will be even more formidable if you concentrate all your strength on a point.
10303156.ch: 前辈一拳发出，能够崩山裂石，倒海翻江。而您将全身力道聚于一点，蓄力发出，无坚不摧，是为“千钧一发”。

10303157.en: I also heard of your recent insights. You want to infuse the power from your fists into a strand of hair to forge the most powerful weapon with the most common material, and that's why it is named Sharp Strand. It can shatter... the distracting thoughts in my soul.
10303157.ch: 前辈近来屡有感悟，更将拳力转于发丝，随手发出，即有无穷力量。这法子可以……可以精准击碎神识内的杂念。

10303158.en: Tianyi: Indeed, but it is only theoretically feasible. The strand may eliminate the unwanted thoughts, but it may decapitate or crush you as well.
10303158.ch: 天一：这不过是我的构想，你以灌注我拳力的发丝开颅铲除杂念，亦有可能立即身首异处，化为一滩肉泥。

10303159.en: My condition keeps worsening, and I guess I wouldn't end in a better way if I let it be.
10303159.ch: 我的情形继续恶化，也不见得有什么好下场……

10303160.en: Yet it would be too risky. I know a mysterious master once created a set of fist moves a long time ago, and maybe I could gain valuable insights or find the solution to your condition from it.
10303160.ch: 这样太过危险。这样吧，我知道八荒之中曾有一名前辈创下一门拳法，只要得到这门拳法，我两相参照当有所益。为你治病的成数便大大增加了。

10303161.en: Thank you, senior. I'll fetch the manual soon.
10303161.ch: 前辈，我这便去将拳法找来。

10303163.en: Seeing you are reading the booklet on the desk, {name|B} dashes into your side and snatches it.
10303163.ch: {name|B}看见你正在查看桌上薄册，急急连跨两步，来到你面前一把夺过薄册。

10303165.en: But you still read it, right? GO OUT!
10303165.ch: 你既然知道不该，那为何还看？出去！

10303166.en: {name|B} looks at you silently as you retreat from her residence. You can feel her scalding gaze on your back.
10303166.ch: {name|B}一言不发的看着你离开，她灼灼目光一直盯视着你。

10303167.en: You hear her hurried steps just as you step out of her door.
10303167.ch: 你才离开屋中，只听得内屋女子急步追了出来。

10303169.en: This is Mourning Tea. Drink it at dawn and it will kick off when the sun rises, rendering your flesh corrupted and your bones eroded. Have a try?
10303169.ch: 这叫卯骨茶。卯时破晓，只需喝下此茶，一旦日出破晓，便将毒发。届时全身皮肉烂尽，白骨露出，惨不可言。你敢不敢喝？

10303170.en: {name|B} looks somewhat annoyed. She drinks up the liquid in the porcelain vial and turns away into her room.
10303170.ch: {name|B}微现怒色，将递给你的瓷瓶仰首喝尽，头也不回的回到屋中。

10303171.en: Remember to drink it as soon as possible. A stale poison will only bring you great suffer once it loses its deadly potency.
10303171.ch: 谨记尽快服用，否则毒性减弱，只将你药得肠穿肚烂，那可不妙。

10303172.en: {name|B} finishes speaking with a grin and walks into her room.

10303173.en: Hmph. I guess my words crossed someone, so I give it to you as compensation in case you hold a grudge against me. Alright! Take it or not, it's up to you.
10303173.ch: 哼，刚刚我说的话有点重了，这不是怕你会小鸡肚肠，心里不高兴，就专程来赔个礼么？嘿嘿，所以你敢不敢要？

10303174.en: Hah. You are so straightforward in taking gifts. See you.
10303174.ch: 哼，收礼倒是爽快。我回了，再见。

10303175.en: You drink up the tea and feel its chilly flows circle inside you, bringing you a refreshing comfort.
10303175.ch: 你将清茶一口喝尽，只觉数股冰凉的气息，遍游全身，让你舒适不已。

10303176.en: Oh? Good to see you here. I was about to set off for something, but a monster blocked my way. Help me kill it. You won't let slip the chance to do me a favor, right?
10303176.ch: 哎？你来得正好。喂，我要去找个东西。那地方有只妖兽守着，你帮我对付了。我可是受伤的弱女子，你不会不帮我吧？

10303177.en: {name|B} brings you to a cave dwelling. A monster crouches before you; you can even hear its strange snoring. {name|B} smiles and lets out a yell, and the creature begins to notice you.
10303177.ch: {name|B}将你带到一个洞府前面，只见前方妖兽蛰伏，呼噜噜的发出奇怪的低吼。{name|B}嘴角微微一扬，发声叫喊，引来妖兽注意。

10303178.en: Hah. It is going to charge toward us. Show your strength! I must go for other matters.
10303178.ch: 嘿嘿，这妖兽冲咱来了，我先走一步。

10303179.en: Don't die. Or I'll see you as a useless braggart.
10303179.ch: 可别死了啊。不然我可要看不起你。

10303180.en: I believe that it would not be a challenging opponent to you. I'll take the thing I said back, and please defeat the monster as soon as possible.
10303180.ch: 以你修为，对付这妖兽那是绰绰有余，我去取东西。赶紧击败妖兽。

10303181.en: You defeated the monster, and {name|B} also retreated from the cave. She holds a large crystal in her palms and examines it, but moments after, she clenches it into her fists with a wicked grin, and the crystal is shattered into shards. {name|B} picks a large shard and hands it to you.
10303181.ch: 你将妖兽击败，{name|B}亦从洞府内离开。其时她拿着一枚硕大的晶石，正仔细端详。片刻后她脸上微露邪气，然后合掌一握，手中晶石顿时碎裂散落。{name|B}将挑出碎片中较为完整的部分递到你面前。

10303184.en: Though it's so hideous, it would be useful to you.
10303184.ch: 这玩意虽然长得丑，对你却是有点用处的。

10303185.en: I thought you would be grateful because I ventured into here and found the gift for you. But you look so unmoved... Fine, never mind.
10303185.ch: 我以为你会看在我一心一意为你拿这东西的份上而感激涕零的，结果就这样？罢了罢了。

10303186.en: {name|B} grins and walks away from your side.

10303187.en: You see {name|B} is fighting against two persons in black. She seems grim but anxious; it must be a harsh battle.
10303187.ch: 只见{name|B}一人双战两名黑衣人，她略有邪气的脸上，露出凝重的神情，似乎以一敌二，已经颇为艰难。

10303190.en: The person in black is about to say something, but {name|B} sheds her opponents a cold glimpse and makes a waving gesture. Silence falls on the battlefield at the next moment.
10303190.ch: 黑衣人正要说话，{name|B}目光中透出寒意，随手一拂，两人顿时没了动静。

10303192.en: You need to ask this one, but my opponent wouldn't talk with you anymore due to an obvious reason.
10303192.ch: 那你该问他。不过可惜了，现在他已经不会说话了。

10303193.en: I always find people annoying, and I guess they have the same feeling about me as well. Maybe the two reasons both played a role this time. I don't know their thoughts.
10303193.ch: 我经常看别人不顺眼，别人大概也会看我不顺眼。这回，大概两者都有一些，而我不太清楚他们是怎么想的。

10303194.en: Hah. Sounds like a caring mom worrying about her child.
10303194.ch: 嘿嘿，不知道的还以为你是我娘了。

10303196.en: {name|B}'s expression softens for only a moment before becoming grim again. She looks at the two persons on the ground and leaves after waving goodbye.
10303196.ch: {name|B}脸上的寒意有那么一瞬间散去了，不过立时又重新变得冷冰冰的，她看了躺在地上两名黑衣人一眼，朝你挥了挥手后转过头便走了。

10303197.en: You hear someone talking near you...
10303197.ch: 只听得不远处传来人语之声……

10303198.en: I didn't expect that you dare to attack and kill the person from the Pavilion. That villain got Taoist Minds by murdering people and then planted the crime on us, and we have all had enough of him. Now we would be glad to find him dead.
10303198.ch: 没想到你会主动找到道心阁的人下杀手。那个恶徒杀人取道心还栽赃在我们头上，我早就看他不顺眼了。如今解决了他，总算是大快人心。

10303199.en: Heh. It seems that they are not as noble as they said. There are also many scums in the Taoist Mind Pavilion too.
10303199.ch: 嘿嘿，你这么一说。道心阁好像也确是良莠不齐，充斥着许许多多的废物、垃圾呢。

10303200.en: So that's why they can't defeat us. But... do you have any thoughts on why we couldn't eliminate them as well? In my opinion, that's because we also have many scums on our side, right?
10303200.ch: 难怪他们一直都没法赢过咱们。不过话又说回来了，为什么咱们也没能打败道心阁呢？嗯，一定是因为，我们这边也有不少废物、垃圾，你说对吧？

10303202.en: Do you really think I don't know? You murdered cultivators to get their Taoist Minds and lied to our elders, inviting us so many troubles.
10303202.ch: 你以为我不知道吗？你瞒着长老杀人、私取道心、惹起争端，已经多少次了？

10303203.en: And naturally, we would be glad to find you dead too.
10303203.ch: 依我说啊，把你也杀了，才叫大快人心呢。

10303204.en: Who... are you?! No! Get away from me!
10303204.ch: 你、你是谁？！别乱来……别乱来！

10303205.en: Heh, a useless person. At least you excel in fleeing.
10303205.ch: 废物，手上本事不怎样，脚上的功夫倒是了得。

10303206.en: You sneak near them, but they are no longer in the spot.
10303206.ch: 你慢步走近，只见前方已经空落落的了无人影。

10303207.en: A faint scent drifts into your nose just as you come near to {name|B}'s residence.
10303207.ch: 你才来到{name|B}住处附近，便隐约闻到一股若有若无的淡香。

10303208.en: You follow the scent and find {name|B} is looking at an earthen pot in front of her with a grim smile. The cyan liquid in the pot is bubbling, and she only nods after smelling it. Then she holds the pot in her hands, apparently trying to drink it up.
10303208.ch: 你循香气前行，只见不远处{name|B}一脸狞笑的看着身前的瓦罐。瓦罐中冒起一个又一个的青色气泡。她轻嗅烟气，点了点头，然后端起瓦罐，似乎要将瓦罐内的液体一口饮尽。

10303209.en: I made it, finally. Good sister, this will be your last cup.
10303209.ch: 总算配好了，好姐妹，今日便是你毕命之时了。

10303210.en: {name|B} quivers in hearing your voice. Her grimness suddenly faded away, and now she seems to be at a loss. She takes only a brief look at the pot and throws it to the ground in a hurry; her face turns pale as if she is frightened.
10303210.ch: {name|B}听你发问，猛的全身一震，同时脸上的邪气迅速散去，露出茫然之色。她看了看手中瓦罐，瞬间花容失色，将其抛落地上。

10303211.en: {name|B} seems to be disconcerted. She snaps her fingers, and the remaining cyan potion bursts into flame.
10303211.ch: {name|B}看起来似乎有点失措。慌乱中，她打个响指，点起一个火头将剩余青色液体全部烧毁。

10303212.en: She... found it finally... made the poison... She wants to kill me?!
10303212.ch: 她……她还是找到、找到了……配好毒药？她、她要毒死我？！

10303213.en: You are... here? Sorry, I'm... What happened... I'll go.
10303213.ch: 你……你来啦？对不起……我，我有点糊涂，失陪。

10303214.en: {name|B} begins to stutter. She then walks away from you with a hesitant smile.
10303214.ch: {name|B}语无伦次的说了几句话，便勉强笑笑转身离去了。

10303215.en: You knock the pot out of {name|B}'s hands and see it shattered on the ground. {name|B} quivers at hearing the sound; her grimness suddenly faded away, and now she seems to be at a loss. She looks at the shards, and her face turns pale.
10303215.ch: 你出手打掉{name|B}手中之物。那瓦罐落地，啪啦一声，摔成满地碎片。{name|B}听了瓦罐碎裂之声，浑身一震，同时脸上的邪气迅速散去，露出茫然之色。她看了看地上碎片，顿时脸色剧变。

10303216.en: You come to {name|B}'s residence and find no one here. The drawers and cabinets in her room are all opened as if they had just undergone a thorough rummage. There are two booklets on the desk, but they are both damaged and only a few pages are legible.
10303216.ch: 你来到{name|B}住处，只见内室空无一人，屋中一应抽屉柜子都被打开。似乎有人翻箱倒柜，正在寻找什么。而内室桌上放着两本破旧薄册，但均已被撕碎，仅余部分可以观看。

10303217.en:
Year X, Month X
I feel like I just woke up from sleep, and now I am just half conscious and don't know who I am.
And I even forget what I intended to do. Seems that I need to write them down.
The Mindsnap Temple plans to get the Reunion Circle again.

Year X, Month X
Recently, I feel increasingly dizzy. I fell into a coma just now, right?
Or is someone like the other me just woke up?
Many signs have proved my guess.
10303217.ch:
某年某月记
感觉好像睡了一觉，脑袋迷迷糊糊的，我也分不清自己是谁。
我甚至有点记不清本来要做什么，看来必须记下来了。
蚀心殿意欲再次争夺“道一心环”。

某年某月记
近日出现晕眩症状的频率增加了。我晕过去了，是真的吗？
我感觉是有另一个我，醒过来了。
种种蛛丝马迹显示，便是这样。

10303218.en:
Year X, Month X
This month my dizziness decreased, and I feel like I'm restoring health.
My head always aches whenever I wake up.
And my forehead feels so hot.
Is there anything I could do?

Year X, Month X
There is another me!
But why... Why the other me pledged loyalty to the Mindsnap Temple...
How long has she been here? And how long has she been under the Temple?
And we are... enemies?!
10303218.ch:
某年某月记
这个月晕眩的次数少了，身体似乎也好些了。
我总感觉每次醒来后，总是十分头痛。
触摸额头还十分滚烫。
我该怎么避免这情况？

某年某月记
的确是有另一个我！
为什么会这样？那个我……在效力蚀心殿。
她一直都存在吗？她已经帮助蚀心殿多久了？
我们……是敌人？！

10303219.en:
Year X, Month X
This notebook must be hidden from her...
Obviously, I couldn't carry it with me.
But if I let things go without recording, I will forget them.
So where should I conceal it?

Year X, Month X
She... is my enemy!
That's too bad. Therefore I must keep an eye on her while I am busy helping the Taoist Mind Pavilion.
I'm so exhausted.
10303219.ch:
某年某月记
这本记事，不能让她知道……
贴身收藏显然不是最好的主意。
不作记录，我迟早会忘事。
我应该将记事藏在哪呢？

某年某月记
她……是敌人！
真可恶，一边为道心阁奔走，一边还得防范她。
好累啊。

10303220.en:
Year X, Month X
She always stands to my contrary.
I must eliminate her for myself and for the Taoist Mind Pavilion.
Maybe I need to visit Senior Tianyi again.
Maybe I can kill her by piercing my head with the artifact, Sharp Strand.

Year X, Month X
Am I a monster?
I don't want to make any friend, and cultivators are all villains spending their lives in scheming and betraying.
Sigh. Maybe she is the only one who will be always at my side.
I wonder what kind of person is she, despite being my enemy?
10303220.ch:
某年某月记
她一直跟我作对。
为了自己，为了道心阁，我应该将她铲除。
我应该再找天一前辈。
用“千钧一发”刺入头颅，应该可以将她杀死。

某年某月记
我是个怪物吧？
我不想见任何人，反正修仙者尔虞我诈，也都不是什么好东西。
呵，也许其实陪着我的，就只有她吧？
不知除去跟我作对，她是一个怎么样的人呢？

10303221.en:
Year X, Month X
That's why I hate alcoholic drinks. It feels like my head has been split whenever I wake up.
Why do people drink alcohol? Isn't tea mellow and refreshing?
But maybe my headache is not caused by liquors. Let's get to the point now. This time the Mindsnap Temple has a conflict against the Taoist Mind Pavilion because of the Reunion Circle. I must focus on the matter.

Year X, Month X
I always feel that there is another me.
That is to say, we are residing in the same body. I remember the day when I woke up. I found a teapot boiling before me.
Sigh. The tea smelled like something fermented for a long time. No, no. I would never make such a beverage.
10303221.ch:
某年某月记
这就是为什么我讨厌喝酒的原因，每次醒来，头都要裂开了。
茶那么好喝，为什么要喝酒？
不过，这真的是酒的缘故么？正事要紧，此处蚀心殿与道心阁起争端都为了“道一心环”，我得专心一些。

某年某月记
我总感觉，这个身体内有另一个我。
我们共用一个身体。那天醒来后，我正在煮茶。
天呐，我发誓那茶汤的香气，像发酵了很久很久，受不了。我是绝对不会出这样的茶汤的。

10303222.en:
Year X, Month X
I'm feeling very, very bad.
Is it the most torturing agony? Now all I want to do is to pierce my head with an awl.
Help me...

Year X, Month X
What if I cut off my head with a blade? Will she also die?
Hmph. She's in the Taoist Mind Pavilion. I can't say those from the Pavilion are all villains, but their faith is indeed inflexible.
They will only do harm to the world if they have control over the Taoist Divine Tree.
Is she one of those hypocrites?
10303222.ch:
某年某月记
好难受，我真的好难受。
我不知道这是不是叫痛不欲生，但我现在只想拿根锥子，炸透自己的脑袋。
救救我。

某年某月记
不知道，我用刀子砍下自己头来，是不是就把“她”也杀死了呢？
哼，她，是道心阁的。道心阁么，也不全是坏人，不过他们的信条迂腐得很。
给他们掌控道心树，只会害了八荒大陆。
她会不会是那些虚伪的道心阁成员？

10303223.en:
Year X, Month X
She has read my records. I can feel the unmistakable scent of tea on the first page. It's she.
Therefore I must conceal the notebook. I wrote down important matters in it, and I must keep her from these words.
Damn! She knew the secrets. She would take a chance to bring the Mindsnap Temple troubles.

Year X, Month X
I told all of these matters to the elder.
However, our elder only smiled. She, I mean, the elder, seems to have an alternative plan.
Maybe I should no longer be in the Mindsnap Temple.
10303223.ch:
某年某月记
她看过我的记事。扉页上有很独特的茶香气，是她留下的。
这里面记录了许多重要的大事。不能让她知道，我得找个地方藏起来。
不好！她知道了许多机密，她会出手对付蚀心殿。

某年某月记
我对长老坦白了。
长老只是笑了笑，她似乎另有安排。
我觉得我不适合继续为蚀心殿效力。

10303224.en:
Year X, Month X
Answer betrayal with betrayal.
I'll repay her for what she has done to me.

Day X
This cultivator is interesting. My harsh words have no effect on that person.
Sometimes I even hesitate to speak them out.
I can feel myself envying. She will like the person too. Certainly.
I think she may be more tender and soft, and maybe the cultivator likes her more.
But I am not certain about her characteristics. Maybe she is soft, I guess.
10303224.ch:
某年某月记
她不仁，我不义。
别怪我心狠手辣。

某某日记
这个人真好玩，我说话这么难听，也不生气。
有时候真不忍心对这家伙恶言相向。
我真嫉妒，她一定也会喜欢这家伙吧？
我感觉她是个温柔的人，也一定更招那家伙喜欢。
她，是不是个温柔的人呢？

10303225.en: The pages vanish into a strain of dust just as you finish reading.
10303225.ch: 你才读完薄册内容，手中残页便化作一缕粉尘飘散了。

10303226.en: You see {name|B} is trying to smash an array in front of her with energy. Finally, she manage to break it, but the next moment a Mythical Beast leaps out from it and charges at the lady.
10303226.ch: {name|B}走在前面不断发出灵力破坏远处一个结界。那界壁不堪巨力，终于破碎，但是里面却扑出一只大妖兽来。

10303227.en: Damn! She led me into her trap...
10303227.ch: 可恶，她在故布疑阵，引我入彀……

10303228.en: {name|B} is engaging in a fierce battle against the Mythical Beast, and you even can't tell which one will win...
10303228.ch: {name|B}与大妖兽殊死恶战，正自难分难解。

10303229.en: Just as you are about to help her, {name|B} falls to the ground unconsciously. But she wakes up immediately, and seeing the monster in front, her face pales.
10303229.ch: 你正要出手助战，{name|B}竟突然垂首软倒地上。不过她马上醒觉，眼看妖兽扑来，立时脸色剧变。

10303230.en: Oh no. I got caught in my own trap!

10303231.ch: 是、是你……你救了我……你走开！

10303232.en: Ugh... My head... I must... I must end it, or I will...
10303232.ch: 呃啊……头好痛……一定……一定要做个了断了，再这样下去……

10303233.en: She wants to live... wants to kill me. I won't let her win!
10303233.ch: 她……想自保……要杀死我，我不会让她得逞的！

10303234.en: You won't find my secret worth knowing. You go. Go away!
10303234.ch: 你不会想知道的。你走开，走得远远的！！

10303235.en: I'm not okay... I'm feeling so bad... My head...
10303235.ch: 我不好……我好难受，头好痛……

10303237.en: A strange expression flits through {name|B}'s face - maybe another she just woke up. She wipes her eyes with her hand and gazes into the water stain on it. Then, after a deep inhale, she turns back and runs away.
10303237.ch: {name|B}脸色微微一变，似乎又变了另一个人。用手轻轻拂过眼睑，然后呆呆的看着手背上的水迹，这才深深的吸了口气，转身跑了开去。

10303238.en: You find {name|B} is fighting against the members of the Taoist Mind Pavilion.
10303238.ch: 你找到{name|B}，却发现她正与道心阁之人斗在一处。

10303239.en: Our elder has ordered us to capture her and bring her back to the Pavilion if the other personality appears.
10303239.ch: 长老有令，若是另一人格出现，便生擒拿下，逮回阁中。

10303240.en: But she looks exactly the same, and why...
10303240.ch: 明明是同一个人……怎么就不是……

10303242.en: {name|B} knocks down the two with a rapid move and looks around coldly.
10303242.ch: {name|B}眨眼间将两人击倒，然后目无表情的扫视场内。

10303243.en: Didn't your companion tell you to focus?
10303243.ch: 你的同伴不是让你专心一些么？

10303244.en: Oh, no! She, the woman... My friends, I'll avenge you...
10303244.ch: 啊！！可恶，她、她……朋友们，我会替你报仇的……

10303245.en: {name|B}'s grimness fades away, and a solemn expression appears on her face. She rides on an artifact and glides away the next moment.
10303245.ch: {name|B}凶悍的神色逐渐褪去，但神情却变得十分凝重，她召出法器御空而去，眨眼间去得远了。

10303246.en: You see {name|B} breaks into the building in front. Then, battle cries come out of it.
10303246.ch: 只见{name|B}闯入前方建筑，里面同时杀声大起，似乎已在厮杀。

10303247.en: You enter the building and find several persons in black on the ground. {name|B} is fighting against three opponents from the Mindsnap Temple.
10303247.ch: 你进入建筑，只见地上横躺着三四个黑衣人，而{name|B}则仍与三名蚀心殿黑衣人交手。

10303248.en: You murdered my fellows from the Taoist Mind Pavilion. Now you'll get what you deserve.
10303248.ch: 你害我道心阁成员，今日要蚀心殿加倍奉还。

10303250.en: You fool! She is not {name|B}. She has two personalities...
10303250.ch: 傻子，这哪是是{name|B}！她有两重人格……

10303251.en: {name|B}'s energy interrupted the speaking person, and her opponent collapsed to the ground motionlessly. She is now focusing on the remaining two enemies, but just when she is about to finish off them, {name|B} staggers and kneels down; her face contorts in pain.
10303251.ch: 这人话没说完就被{name|B}灵力射中，顿时委顿地上，再无生机。她手中连发攻势似乎要一举杀死剩余二人。眼看剩余二人便要不敌，{name|B}却突然跪倒地上，脸上神色变得十分痛苦。

10303252.en: You defeated the enemies and came to aid {name|B}. Her eyes are closed and her forehead feels hot. Her darkened face indicates she is in her last breath, but she keeps murmuring on something.
10303252.ch: 你将对手一一击败后扶起跪倒的{name|B}。其时她双眼紧闭，额头滚烫发热，满脸黑气，已然奄奄一息。但嘴里却一直说着什么。

10303253.en: I want to... go home... She planted many flowers in our courtyard, and I... want to see them again, those lovely flowers...
10303253.ch: 我想……回家……她在家的院子里种了很多小花儿，我很喜欢，我还想看看……再看一眼。

10303255.en: You bring {name|B} to her residence. The heat on her forehead soon disappeared, and she opened her eyes. She gazes blankly at the ceiling, then, she turns her head to you.
10303255.ch: 你将{name|B}带回住处，不多时她额头高热褪去，人也渐渐醒转，她呆呆的看着屋顶片刻这才转头看着你。

10303256.en: You are here? You must have a lot of questions.
10303256.ch: 你来了啊？你一定有许多疑问吧？

10303257.en: Just ask them to me... My reputation has been ruined, and I guess people would see me as a monster.
10303257.ch: 你问吧……我已经丑态百出……大家都会觉得我一个怪物吧？

10303258.en: I have two personalities. When the other me appears, I usually feel dizzy and become unconscious.
10303258.ch: 我体内有两重人格，通常我会感觉晕眩，然后失去意识。另一个我，这时候便出现了。反之亦然。

10303259.en: Yes, I am under the Taoist Mind Pavilion, and she, the Mindsnap Temple. I guess she is straightforward and determined... She is entirely different from me...
10303259.ch: 不错，我……是为道心阁效力。而她，则听命于蚀心殿。我猜她应该是个较为直爽的性子，做事也更为果敢……与我完全不同……

10303260.en: I visited master cultivators for a solution. They said that the condition would threaten my life since our soul would suffer a prolonged attrition whenever I or she emerged.
10303260.ch: 我曾寻访高人问及身体情形，据他们所说，我已经十分危险。因为每次我消失或者出现都会对神识造成伤害。当然，她也是这样的。

10303261.en: And these days we keep emerging frequently, and our body has been impaired due to it... If I let it be, I'll die... And maybe she will die too.
10303261.ch: 近日里，她和我频繁交替出现，身体已经大为虚弱……我知道再这样下去，我会死掉。也许她也会死掉……

10303262.en: I don't know. I asked for a senior's advice and hoped to use the Sharp Strand to kill her, that is, to deliver a concentrated punch on my soul with the pointed artifact.
10303262.ch: 我也不知道。我曾向一位高人问计，我认为以他独特的“千钧一发”之技，可以将强大的拳力精准送入我神识之内，将“她”杀死。

10303263.en: The senior warned me that the attempt may fail. But the worst ending would only be death, which is perhaps not so bad compared to my life today. Am I really living? I can't discern who am I, or whether I am a breathing being or a ghost.
10303263.ch: 不过这位高人却不敢保证定能救我。最坏的情况也就是死罢了。我这样人不人，鬼不鬼的，连自己是哪一个都分不清，又哪里算是活着呢？

10303264.en: Heh. Only one of us can live. People would shed tears for her death, right? I wonder who will weep for me if I die.
10303264.ch: 呵，我们两个只能活一个。杀死“她”，一定有许多人为她难过吧？倘若情况调转过来，也不知有谁为我伤心难过。

10303265.en: I am just... a strange monster...

10303266.en: Heh... Is there a person more pathetic than me?
10303266.ch: 呵呵……天下间有比我更可悲的存在吗？

10303267.en: My plan? Do you think I have any plans? I even don't know whether I can live to the next day.
10303267.ch: 我还能有什么打算？我还配有什么打算吗？呵，我连明天是生是死都不晓得呢。

10303268.en: You... leave here, please... Leave me alone...
10303268.ch: 你……你走吧……我想一个人呆着……

10303269.en: {name|B} turns away from you and no longer responds to your words. Her shoulders are shaking - is she feeling unwell, or is she weeping?
10303269.ch: {name|B}说完便转过身去，不再理你。她肩膀微微抽搐，也不知是身体难受还是在暗自哭泣。

10303270.en: I kept many secrets from you, but you trusted me all the time... Thank you.
10303270.ch: 一直以来我有许多事情瞒着你……你却如此信任我，多谢你。

10303271.en: But now, please leave here and let me alone, okay?
10303271.ch: 但是、但是现在，你让我一个人呆着吧，好不好？

10303273.en: You come to {name|B}'s residence and find it has been tidied up again. The furniture in the room, as well as the floor and the windows, are neat and clean. There is a letter on the desk in the inner chamber.
10303273.ch: 你来到{name|B}屋中，里面已经重新收拾整理好了。几案桌椅，门窗地板，均已打扫得一尘不染。而内室几上则放着一纸留书。

10303274.en: You open the letter. Its last several lines are blurred by water drops, but you can feel a strong determination from the wording and the writing of it.
10303274.ch: 信笺上曾落有几滴清水，将尾行若干文字墨迹晕开。而信中无论行文抑或笔迹，均显示出留书者一股强大的决心。

10303275.en:
I reflected on my life and found that my decisions were seldom made by myself.
I can't decide which one will be in this body the next time, and I am only a pawn even in the Taoist Mind Pavilion.
What a sad fate. But now I am going to end it.
In my eyes, the two secret orders both aim to preserve the Taoist Minds in the world.
They both have good intentions.
However, they did much harm to the cultivators and the world in the journey toward their goals.
And their mission will only be delayed endlessly if they keep being distracted by their disputes.
10303275.ch:
回顾生平，我竟发现，自己不曾真正做过多少决定。
是不是我自己，固然身不由主。就连在道心阁中我也不过是一枚棋子。
这样真的很可悲，但这次我打算了结这一切。
其实在我看来，无论道心阁还是蚀心殿他们都是为了道心能够在八荒中长久存在而努力。
他们的初衷都是好的。
只不过在达成目标的过程中，他们总是做了许多伤害当下修仙者、伤害八荒的事情。
如果他们两个再为了彼此间的是非而争执不休，只会无限推延他们的达成目标的时间。

10303276.en: The letter's surface is uneven, resembling something carved on the paper. You turn it to the back and find a map drawn with a piece of charcoal. Its caption reads "SAVE HER".
10303276.ch: 你阅读之际，发现信笺表面微有凸起之状，极似笔划刻痕。而你翻转之后，发现背面竟用碳笔画着一副地图，下面还标注“救她”两字。

10303277.en: The map and the words are only more legible than scribbles. The one who left them must be in a hurry at that time.
10303277.ch: 背面的地图和刻字都十分仓促，可以看见留书者十分情急失措。

10303278.en: So, she left a letter and went to the final battlefield, hoping to end the dispute between the Pavilion and the Temple, as well as her fate. Another she woke up before the lady set out, and the writings on the back side were hers...
10303278.ch: 她留书前往道心阁蚀心殿决战现场终结一切，她临行之际，另外一个人格觉醒过来，在背后留下地图与文字嘱咐……

10303280.en:
This won't do any good to the world, or to the Pavilion and the Temple.
But all of these matters are in the far future that is beyond my reach.
At least I can prevent the conflict from worsening. They have killed many opposite members because of the Reunion Circle.
No need to do that! The Reunion Circle is here. I've found it. Now if I hand it to the Taoist Mind Pavilion, things will be settled.
Elder Tianxuan has learned how to eliminate her from Senior Tianyi, which is the same reason I visited the senior.
She is under the command of Bitterfly, and I guess Bitterfly must have known how to kill me.
Therefore, the opposite elder will certainly try to prevent me, or even wipe me out at that time.
10303280.ch:
这样对八荒、对道心阁蚀心殿都不是好事。
但是那样遥远的事情我已经管不了了。
不过我可以阻止眼前的争端。此次为了“道一心环”，他们已经互相杀害对方很多成员了。
这完全没有必要。我已经找到“道一心环”了。我只要将之交给道心阁，就能平息他们之间的争端。
天玄长老其实早已从天一前辈处获知杀死“她”的法子，我也由此辗转找到天一前辈。
她，是蝶怨的手下。想必蝶怨也已掌握杀死我的法子。
到时，她会千方百计阻止我，乃至杀死我。

10303281.en:
But never mind. Now it's time to make my own choice.
My own!
10303281.ch:
不过这没关系了，这次我要自己选一次。
一定！

10303282.en: You sneak into the place and see persons from the Taoist Mind Pavilion and the Mindsnap Temple standing on the two sides of the battlefield. At its center, Bitterfly and Tianxuan are engaging in a deadly fight.
10303282.ch: 你潜入道心阁与蚀心殿的决战之所，只见无数黑衣人分立两边，遥遥对峙。为首蝶怨与天玄则在进行死斗。

10303283.en: And you see {name|B} crouching on somewhere high above. She is watching them silently.
10303283.ch: 而{name|B}则暗中匍匐高处，正俯瞰这一切。

10303284.en: Why are you here? Go away, that's too dangerous!
10303284.ch: 你、你怎么来这了？这里太危险了！你快走！

10303285.en: I have never been more sober than today. I'll do what I must do.
10303285.ch: 我从来没像今天这么清醒过，这是我要做的事。

10303286.en: No. I'll end all of these matters...
10303286.ch: 不，今天我一定要了结一切……

10303287.en: {name|B} suddenly begins to quiver. Her expression twists under great pain, and her face reddens. Sweat streams down from her forehead.
10303287.ch: 便在此时，{name|B}突然颤抖起来，她神色渐渐变得十分痛楚，一张脸瞬间涨红，豆大的汗滴涔涔而下……

10303288.en: Fool! Do you want to die, or do you want me to die? Only mad persons will say themselves sober!
10303288.ch: 傻子，你是自己想死，还是要害死我？！你清醒？你糊涂着呢！

10303289.en: Why... just at this time... If you were here, you would also want to end these... You and I are the same!
10303289.ch: 怎么……偏偏是这个时候……你，换你，你也会终结这一切。你就是我，我就是你！

10303290.en: All beings cherish their lives. And now you want to give up it?
10303290.ch: 蝼蚁尚要苟且偷生，你是连畜生都不如？！

10303292.en: The leaders from the Pavilion and the Temple noticed the quarrel between {name|B}'s two personalities. They look to the place at the same time.
10303292.ch: {name|B}正在两重人格正在互相争执，下方道心阁与蚀心殿的首领同时发现这边的声息，一起朝这边看来。

10303294.en: The condensed energy from the two leaders landed on {name|B}'s shelter. {name|B} falls down with rumbling rocks. She tries to stand up, but after several failed attempts, she kneels down again.
10303294.ch: 两方首领一起发出灵力击中{name|B}所处位置，坍塌声中，{name|B}栽落下方，她几次挣扎站起，最终跪倒地上。

10303295.en: The members on the solemn battlefield seem to be agitated by {name|B}'s arrival, and a new round of fighting between them unfolds.
10303295.ch: {name|B}的出现仿佛落水的石子，激起了阵阵水波，场中微妙的平衡，瞬间被打破，双方竟因此激战起来。

10303296.en: You rush to {name|B}'s side. The two personalities are vying for her body, and she is suffering from a dangerous fever. She couldn't stand one more minute of delay.
10303296.ch: 你来到{name|B}身边，其时她两重人格交替出现，浑身高热难耐，再有拖延，二者势必同时毕命。

10303297.en: What should I do... Follow the Taoist Mind Pavilion and... My head hurts... The Pavilion opens a peaceful way to the future...
10303297.ch: 我要怎么办……道心阁……救我，头好痛！道心阁能让八荒更加和平过度到未来……

10303298.en: No... The Temple! I'm feeling so bad... Follow the Mindsnap Temple, right?
10303298.ch: 不……蚀心殿……蚀心殿，我好难受！你说……选蚀心殿才是对的，是吗？

10303299.en: Just at this time, a crowd of members in fight charge into your location, separating you from {name|B}. These fervid mobs even take you as their enemy and begin to attack you...
10303299.ch: 便在这时，一群死斗中的蚀心殿与道心阁门人汹涌而来，隔绝了你与{name|B}。这些门人杀红了眼，瞬间将你卷入战斗之中……

10303300.en: The members from the Pavilion and the Temple are all formidable enemies. You feel you will soon be overwhelmed by their endless reinforcements.
10303300.ch: 道心阁蚀心殿的门人均十分厉害，你击败一批又来一批，渐自抵挡不住。

10303301.en: But a strange power comes howling through the air at this moment. The persons in black around you are blown away like listless kites, and a fair hand grasps your arm. You are led by the mysterious figure and manage to retreat after many dodges and shuns.
10303301.ch: 正在此时，突然一股恐怖的力量排云而至，将你身边的黑衣人打得如纸鸢般远远飞开。于此同时，一只雪白的手拉住了你，带着你穿插来去，巧妙地从战场中退了开去。

10303302.en: Unfortunately, she gets caught by the members of the Taoist Mind Pavilion and the Mindsnap Temple.
10303302.ch: 眼看便要离开战场，她却分别被道心阁与蚀心殿的门人拿住。

10303303.en: She tried to get rid of them, but her attempt failed. She only has time to leave you a word that sounds like "farewell".
10303303.ch: 她无法挣脱，只轻轻说了句话，你依稀听来，似乎是“别了”。

10303304.en: With a sad smile, she pushes you out of the battlefield. Then she closes the gate, keeping you away from the fateful fight.
10303304.ch: 她凄然一笑，将你推离场地，然后用灵力关闭大门，将你隔绝在危机之外。

10303308.en: But a strange pale fog comes from nowhere at this moment. The persons in black around you collapse to the ground after inhaling the fog, and a fair hand grasps your arm. You are led by the mysterious figure and manage to retreat after many dodges and shuns.
10303308.ch: 正在此时，突然一股白色的烟雾蔓延而至，你身边的黑衣人吸入烟气纷纷倒地。于此同时，一只雪白的手拉住了你，带着你穿插来去，巧妙地从战场中退了开去。

10303313.en: You see a familiar figure in front. Maybe it's an old friend.
10303313.ch: 你看见一个背影十分熟悉，似乎乃是故人。

10303314.en: It's been a long time, my friend.

10303315.en: I am still alive. I'm lucky enough to survive the battle.
10303315.ch: 我没死，虽然历经艰险，最后却侥幸活下来了。

10303316.en: I remember the day. When I suffered from the intense headache, I heard you telling me to stand with the Taoist Mind Pavilion...
10303316.ch: 我记得当日头痛欲裂，不知道该怎么办才好。你却说了选道心阁……

10303317.en: And I then felt the other me lost her vitality.
10303317.ch: 那一刻我分明感觉到另外一个“我”瞬间失去了活力。

10303318.en: I took the chance and delivered the Reunion Circle to our elder.
10303318.ch: 而我便乘着这空隙，将“道一玄环”送到长老手中。

10303319.en: At that time, Bitterfly already knocked me down with the Mind Mirage, and I felt I would soon die.
10303319.ch: 当时蝶怨以“幻蜃蚀心”将我击倒，我原本以为便要一命呜呼。

10303320.en: However, she, the other me, protected me by sacrificing herself to the poison aiming at our soul... She died, and I survived.
10303320.ch: 没想到另外一个“我”，却在神识内为我挡下毒药的毒性……她死了，我却得以重新活过来。

10303321.en: I noticed you were surrounded by the mobs, so I activated the Sharp Strand from Senior Tianyi to dispel them. That's how you were saved.
10303321.ch: 后来我看你被道心阁蚀心殿门人围攻，便射出天一前辈赠予的“千钧一发”将众人击退，救下了你。

10303322.en: Maybe I'll say it in other words. I felt that she lost her hope at that time. She did not want to live anymore.
10303322.ch: 我换个说法吧？“她”当时给我的感觉，应该是灰心了，不想活了。

10303323.en: We emerged alternatively on that day. Our soul was seriously impaired, and we would both die if there were any further delay.
10303323.ch: 当时我两交替出现，神识已在崩溃边缘，继续拖延，我两势必一起死亡。

10303324.en: Maybe she felt exhausted or bored. Maybe she just wanted to protect me, or maybe... she chose to follow your words. I am not certain.
10303324.ch: 也许她只是累了，厌倦了。也许她只是想保护我？也许，她是想尊重你的选择？我也搞不懂。

10303325.en: But anyway, I'd say thanks to my sister for granting me a second chance to live and to be myself.
10303325.ch: 但无论如何，我都很感激她让我有机会真真正正的做自己，切切实实的活一次。

10303326.en: They, the Pavilion and the Temple, both thought I was dead after the fight. Maybe it's good news to me.
10303326.ch: 当日道心阁蚀心殿大战之后，他们都以为我已经死了。这对于我是一件好事。

10303327.en: I want to take a walk around here and think about myself in silence. Maybe I'll find my way in the end.
10303327.ch: 今后我想周围走走，静静的想一想，也许最后我会找到自己的方向吧？

10303328.en: Well, there is another thing to tell you. Stand here.

10303330.en: Hey, my friend. Glad to see you are alive.
10303330.ch: 你还活得好好的嘛，朋友。

10303331.en: So you thought I was dead? No. Such a clever person survived the battle, of course.
10303331.ch: 哼，你盼着我死是吧？我跟你说，那天亏得我机警，总算侥幸活下来了。

10303332.en: I suffered an intense headache that day. I thought I was about to die and felt at a loss. Then I seemed to hear you telling me to follow the Mindsnap Temple.
10303332.ch: 那天我头痛得厉害，我都以为自己要死了。那时候我都糊涂了，但好像听到你说让我选蚀心殿。

10303333.en: And I then felt the other me lose her vitality at that moment.
10303333.ch: 就在那一刻，另外一个“我”瞬间失去了活力。

10303334.en: I took the chance and delivered the Reunion Circle to Bitterfly, our elder.
10303334.ch: 而我便乘着这空隙，将“道一玄环”送到蝶怨长老手中。

10303335.en: At that time, Tianxuan already knocked me down with the Sharp Strand, and I felt I would soon die.
10303335.ch: 当时天玄以“千钧一发”将我击倒，我原本以为便要一命呜呼。

10303336.en: However, she, the other me, protected me by sacrificing herself to the formidable attack aiming at our soul... She died, and I survived.
10303336.ch: 没想到另外一个“我”，却在神识内为我挡下了雷霆万钧之力……她死了，我却得以重新活过来。

10303337.en: I noticed you were surrounded by the mobs, so I activated the Mind Mirage from Senior Lingsu to dispel them. That's how you were saved.
10303337.ch: 后来我看你被道心阁蚀心殿门人围攻，便射出灵素前辈赠予的“幻蜃蚀心”将众人击退，救下了你。

10303342.en: I survived on that day, and the Pavilion and the Temple both thought I was dead.
10303342.ch: 当日混乱中侥幸活命，道心阁与蚀心殿都以为我已经是一个死人了。

10303343.en: It's good news to me. From now on, I can be independent from them.
10303343.ch: 这于我实是一件好事。从今以后，我就能抽身于道心阁与蚀心殿之外。

10303344.en: I want to take a walk around here and think about myself in silence. I'll try to live and see from her point of view, and maybe I could find my way in the future.
10303344.ch: 我想周围走一走，静静的想一想，把事情理清楚了。我想试着用她的眼光去活去看，也许那以后我就能找到方向了吧？

10303506.en: Everyone in the world is fighting for something. They fight with others or with me. Even I am fighting against myself sometimes in my mind, and the fight will never end.
10303506.ch: 世人都爱争，人我之间在争，人群之间在争。就是自己，有时也会在内心进行交战，没有一刻安宁。

10303507.en: You try to pass your Taoist Seed into {name|B}, but a strange power from her soul prevents you.
10303507.ch: 你尝试对{name|B}传入道种，然而她神识中似乎有一股强大的念力阻碍了道种的传入。

10303508.ch: 你我先试着交朋友，好吗？

10303509.en: Well, that's unexpected, and I haven't ever thought about it yet. But we can be friends first.
10303509.ch: 这、这太突然了，我还没考虑过。不过我们能先做朋友。

10303510.en: Sigh. I am not qualified to be a master.
10303510.ch: 唉，我又哪有资格当旁人的师父呢？

10303511.en: Thanks, but I am about to rest here for some days and think about my own matters. It's better not to worry about other things right now.
10303511.ch: 我现在打算好好在这里静养，顺便想些事情，其他事我都会先放一边。对不起。

10303513.en: Thank you, but I must decline such a precious gift.
10303513.ch: 我不能收你的厚礼。不过，谢谢你。

10303514.en: Okay, let's have a spar. Please don't hit too hard.
10303514.ch: 好，你我便来练一练吧。你可要让着我一些啊。

10303515.en: Well, eh... No. I can't have a Dual Cultivation with you.
10303515.ch: 这……不好吧？对不起，我不能跟你双修。

10303516.en: Okay, let's have a debate. You won't ridicule my poor insight, right?
10303516.ch: 好，我们便来论道吧。但我见识不多，盼你不要取笑。

10303517.en: Thank you, but I'm in low spirits now. Maybe next time?
10303517.ch: 抱歉，我暂时没心思呢。改天，好吗？

10303518.en: Joining a sect means to get involved in unnecessary troubles. I prefer to be a carefree, wandering cultivator like what I am right now.
10303518.ch: 加入宗门，容易卷入不必要的纷争，我更希望像现在这样，自由自在的。

10303519.en: Why? If you like it, you could just ask me!
10303519.ch: 你若喜欢这东西，直接问我不就好了嘛!

10303520.en: What? Okay, let's fight! Our friendship ends today, and <r>from now on we're strangers</r>!
10303520.ch: 哼，你要战，便来战。你我之间从此决裂，<r>再无任何情谊</r>！

10303521.en: Follow your destiny's course to live or to die, and I won't care about your feelings today! <r>From now on we're strangers</r>!
10303521.ch: 生死有命，死活听天，别怪我不留情面！<r>从此以后你我再无瓜葛</r>！

10303522.en: Hey, why do you see me like that? You look strange.
10303522.ch: 喂喂，我怎么觉得你看我的眼光有点怪怪的。

10303523.en: I am the one here and now and not anyone else.

10303524.en: No. And why do you have such a whimsical idea?
10303524.ch: 你怎会有这么奇怪的想法？我拒绝。

10303525.en: No. I'm too dim-witted to follow such a brilliant, second-to-none cultivator like you. That's real.
10303525.ch: 不可以。相信我，都是我不好，不是你的问题。

10303526.en: Take me as your master? No. I can't bear to mislead such an innocent little apprentice.
10303526.ch: 拜我为师？我可不要把你这可爱的小东西给教坏了。

10303527.en: Seeking knowledge is the last thing I would do. From the sky to the earth, and from the past to the present, all things sound similarly dull.
10303527.ch: 原谅我不是个爱学习的家伙。天文地理，琴棋书画，医卜星相，我统统不感兴趣。

10303528.en: Take it if that's what you're looking for.

10303529.en: I don't like it. Thanks anyway.
10303529.ch: 我不喜欢这东西，谢谢你。

10303530.en: Go ahead! I'll try not to break your arms or legs. And of course, you shouldn't hit your opponent too hard as well.
10303530.ch: 来，打折你的手臂小腿什么的可别怪我。当然，你是不允许伤到我的。
