10303531.en: What are you thinking about? You can find pleasure in everything other than making fun of me.
10303531.ch: 想什么呢？这世上好玩的东西多了去了。

10303532.en: Alright! Let's see what we can get from your experience.
10303532.ch: 来来来，给我看看你肚子里有多少墨水。

10303534.ch: 呃啊（哈欠），我谢谢你啊，但我拒绝。

10303535.en: Do you like it? You could just tell me, and I'll give you! Do I look like a miser?
10303535.ch: 你喜欢这东西？你告诉我嘛，难道我还会不给你吗？我看起来像是个小气鬼？

10303536.en: Hmph. You helped me out of your interest, right? Fine. <r>From now on, we will be strangers</r>!
10303536.ch: 哼，你当初根本就不是真心帮助我的！也罢，<r>你我从此再无情谊</r>！

10303537.en: I think I was fond of you at some moments, but you let me down. And <r>from now on, we will be strangers</r>!
10303537.ch: 有那么一刻我有一点点喜欢你，可是你让我失望了。以后<r>你我相逢，便是陌路人了</r>！

10303538.en: I always feel that if I fall asleep, I will never wake up again...
10303538.ch: 我总感觉自己睡着了就再也醒不来了……

10303539.en: Has the fateful moment finally come? Will she hate me?
10303539.ch: 还是走到这一步了吗？“她”会恨我吗？

10303540.en: I'm sorry, but I feel very, very disturbed now...

10303545.en: Well, what's this? A gift? Oh... thanks.
10303545.ch: 啊，这个是干什么的？噢，送我？谢谢你。

10303551.en: Ugh... What happened? My head hurts... Have I seen it wrong? I feel someone took something from me.
10303551.ch: 唔……发生什么事……头有点痛……刚刚那是错觉吗？仿佛有人拿走了什么。

10303552.en: How could you harm me when I'm in direst need of help? Fine. <r>From now on, we will be enemies</r>!
10303552.ch: 在我最需要支持的时候，你却对我落井下石吗。也罢，<r>从此以后你我便是仇人了</r>。

10303553.en: You heartless person! Come and have a fight, and <r>I'll never be grateful to you again</r>!
10303553.ch: 没心没肺的家伙！来，战个痛快！<r>我再也不会顾念你的恩情了</r>！

10303555.en: Now I can finally be an ordinary cultivator in this world.
10303555.ch: 现在我总算能试着当一个普通的修仙者了。

10303556.en: Well, no. Why would you have such a thought?
10303556.ch: 你怎会冒出这种奇怪的想法？不过不可以。

10303557.en: (Chuckles.) You... must conceal your affection for a long time, right?
10303557.ch: 噗呲……你……现在才肯说出来啊？

10303558.en: I don't want to be your Master.

10303559.en: I don't want to be your Apprentice.

10303560.en: Just take it if that's what you like.
10303560.ch: 只要你喜欢，尽管拿去便是。

10303561.en: Thank you! I seldom received gifts in the past.
10303561.ch: 谢谢你，以往很少人会送我东西呢。

10303563.en: Well, no. My cultivation reaches a dangerous limit, and a Dual Cultivation at this time may harm you as well.
10303563.ch: 对不起，近日我修炼之际颇有走火之象，暂时无法与你双修。

10303564.en: Fighting here would be making a scene. Let's have a debate instead!
10303564.ch: 动手动脚不好，我们来动动嘴皮子吧！

10303565.en: Thanks, but I must decline you because I'm busy dealing with urgent matters now.
10303565.ch: 对不起，最近我有点事情要处理，不能答应你的要求。

10303566.en: Thanks for your invitation. I'll try my best to get along with other cultivators there.
10303566.ch: 多谢你盛情邀请。我会好好和大家相处的。

10303567.en: Why should you do that? Just ask me for it, and I won't say no to the request!
10303567.ch: 你想要，难道我会不给你吗？直接跟我要嘛！

10303568.en: Oh, I see. <r>Do you want to cut the ties between us? If so, I'll follow your wish</r>.
10303568.ch: 我明白了，<r>你这是要斩断你我之间的所有瓜葛。好吧，我便如你所愿</r>。

10303569.en: {name|B} stretches her hand into your bosom and takes out a piece of jade resembling a half blossom. She hesitates for a moment and fumbles at the same location again, and then, she takes out another piece of jade.
10303569.ch: {name|B}探手入你怀内，微一摸索，竟从你衣服内取出一块呈半朵花似的玉璧。这还不止，她微微一愣之下，再探手入内，竟又取出另外一块花玉来。

10303570.en: {name|B} seems to be astonished by her findings, but at the next moment, she knows why. She puts the two pieces together and joins them into a complete jade blossom, and then you see {name|B} presents it to you shyly.
10303570.ch: {name|B}能从你怀中取出两块玉璧，似乎连她自己也极感意外。但只眨眼间{name|B}似乎已经明白了是怎么回事，她将两块玉璧轻轻一合，拼成一朵完整的花玉，这才讪讪的将之递到你面前。

10303571.en: I didn't expect that... Well, never mind. Now it's yours.
10303571.ch: 没想到……罢了，这东西就送你吧。

10303572.en: This is the Blossom Jade. Its two parts are from the seniors in the Pavilion and the Temple respectively, and it may produce miraculous effects once it is complete. However, the two parts were kept in two different places, and the hostility between the two orders prevented them from joining.
10303572.ch: 此玉佩名为“璇玑花玉”，本是道心阁与蚀心殿的前辈留下的玉璧。此物一旦组合便能衍生奇效，后来两派矛盾越演越烈，这玉佩便分存两地，再无合璧的机会了。
